mcqs.explanation: There can’t be more than one variable or object with the same name in same scope. The scope is same, since the object is passed, it becomes local to function and hence function can’t have one more object of same name.

mcqs.question: Passing an object using copy constructor and pass by value are same.
mcqs.explanation: The copy constructor is used to copy the values from one object to other. Pass by values is not same as copy constructor method. Actually the pass by value method uses a copy constructor to copy the values in a local object.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Object Reference”.

mcqs.question: What is reference to an object?

options.a: a) It is address of an object
options.b: b) It is address of where the variables and methods of object are stored
options.c: c) It is pointer having address of an object
options.d: d) It is address of only variables and not the methods of an object

mcqs.answer: b) It is address of where the variables and methods of object are stored
mcqs.explanation: Reference indicates the address where the object’s variables and methods are stored. It is not actual address of the object. This is done to directly use the variables and methods whenever required.

mcqs.question: Whenever an object is assigned to a variable or passed to a method ________________

options.a: a) Actually the objects aren’t used
options.b: b) Actually only the objects are used
options.c: c) Actually a pointer to an object is used
options.d: d) Actually copy of object is used

mcqs.answer: a) Actually the objects aren’t used
mcqs.explanation: Whenever an object is assigned to a variable or passed to a method, we aren’t actually using objects there. Actually the reference to the objects is used. The reference makes a lot of difference as the main object may or may not get affected depending on the code.

mcqs.question: Does use of object reference in assignment or passing means copy of the object is being used?

options.a: a) No, because the copy would create a new temporary variable
options.b: b) No, because the copy would not help to make changes to main object
options.c: c) Yes, because the reference directly means using address
options.d: d) Yes, because the reference directly means the constructors are involved

mcqs.answer: c) Yes, because the reference directly means using address
mcqs.explanation: We can’t say that the reference involves constructors in passing the objects to some method. The reference is used to denote the addresses and hence to point to the main object itself. There is no copy involved.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following code? 
import java.awt.Point;
class Testing
{
	public static void main(String[] args)
	{
		Point p1,p2;
		p1=new Point(100,100);
		p2=p1;
		p1.x=200;
		p1.y=200;
		System.out.println(“Point 1: ” + p1.x + ”, “ + p1.y);
		System.out.println(“Point 2: ” + p2.x + ”, “ + p2.y);
	}
}
mcqs.explanation: The expected output would be like p2 with values 100, 100. But this is not the case. The tricky part is assignment used (p2=p1;). Here a reference is created from object p1 to p2, and not any new object that would copy p1’s values. Hence when we change the values of p1 object members. There changes are reflected to the object p2 also.

mcqs.question: Is there any explicit use of pointers in java that would be applicable to objects?

options.a: a) Yes, we use reference for this purpose
options.b: b) Yes, we use java arrays for this purpose
options.c: c) No, implicit pointing is possible
options.d: d) No, direct class names should be used

mcqs.answer: c) No, implicit pointing is possible
mcqs.explanation: The question clearly asks if there is any explicit use of pointers related to objects. Pointers are not applicable in java first of all. Secondly, the pointing in java is achieved implicitly using the references and object arrays.

mcqs.question: Can a super class object give reference to a subclass method?

options.a: a) No, it is not possible
options.d: d) No, It’s not possible in few cases only

mcqs.explanation: The object of a super class can never refer to methods of a subclass. Whereas vice versa is possible. If there is an overridden function in subclass, then the object of super class will execute the method of itself and not from the subclass.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following code? 
import java.awt.Point;
class Testing
{
	public static void main(String[] args)
	{
		Point t1,t2,t3;
		t1=new Point(100,100);
		t2=t1;
		t3=t1;
		t1.x=200;
		t1.y=200;
		t2.x=300;
		t3.y=500;
		System.out.println(“Point 1: ” + p1.x + ”, “ + p1.y);
	}
}
mcqs.explanation: When references are used, all the variables point to the same object. Whenever any of the variable changes any values, it will be reflected to all the variables pointing to the same object.

mcqs.question: If a reference variable is declared final then _________________

options.a: a) It can never be reassigned to refer to a different object
options.b: b) It can be assigned to refer to any object anytime
options.c: c) It can never be assigned with any object
options.d: d) It can be assigned with 2 or more objects simultaneously

mcqs.answer: a) It can never be reassigned to refer to a different object
mcqs.explanation: Since the variable is declared final. It will have a constant value throughout the program. It can refer to only one object at a time. And if it was made to refer to none of the object, it would have got no use.

mcqs.question: Which of the members are referred by this pointer usually (Java)?

options.a: a) Members of class where this is used
options.b: b) Member of the parent class where this is used
options.c: c) Members that are passed as argument to the object
options.d: d) Pointers are not applicable in java

mcqs.answer: a) Members of class where this is used
mcqs.explanation: We use this pointer to differentiate the members of the class where this is used to the other inherited or passed variables. The local variables are denoted with this. Or specifically the members of class only.

mcqs.question: How to refer to method of nested class?

options.d: d) depends on where the method is being called

mcqs.answer: d) depends on where the method is being called
mcqs.explanation: This depends on where the method is being called. If the method is called inside the enclosing class itself. Then we can’t use object of enclosing class. If the method is being called within the inner class itself, then its object will also be of no use.

mcqs.question: How many objects can be referenced from the same variables?

options.d: d) 7 at max at same time

mcqs.explanation: There should not be any confusion in how many references can be made from a single variable. A single variable can only point to one object at a time. Even if it’s an array, the name of the array is used and is considered one object name only (representing first array element).

mcqs.question: Java handles memory dynamically and references are deleted as soon as they are out of scope.
mcqs.explanation: In Java, it is inbuilt feature that handles all the memory dynamically. It is not necessary to free or destroy all the references made from a function which is going out of scope. You can call destroy or free methods explicitly but there is no mandatory rule.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Object referencing refers to methods address
options.b: b) Object referencing refers to variable of object
options.c: c) Object referencing points to same address, if assigned by variables
options.d: d) Object referencing is used to point methods

mcqs.answer: c) Object referencing points to same address, if assigned by variables
mcqs.explanation: The object referencing will point to the same address if variables are assigned. All the variables might have a different name but they will point to the same memory location. This is most basic concept of references.

mcqs.question: Invoking a method on a particular object is ____________ sending a message to that object.
mcqs.explanation: The methods invoked on a particular object is same as sending a message with same values to that object. Message would contain values in a particular format that can be used by the object. And calling a method would be just another way to do the same task.

mcqs.question: Can reference to an object be returned from a method?

options.d: d) No, Not possible because referred element would be destroyed

mcqs.explanation: This is possible but not always, since the reference being returned may get destroyed with the return of method. This is an undesirable condition, hence it is not always possible to return references. But it is always possible if the referred element is not local to the method.

links.text: OOPs MCQ: Memory Allocation of Object
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Memory Allocation of Object”.

mcqs.question: What does memory allocation for objects mean?

options.a: a) Actual creation and memory allocation for object members
options.c: c) Creation of data members for a class
options.d: d) Actual creation and data declaration for object members

mcqs.answer: a) Actual creation and memory allocation for object members
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocated for the object members indicates actual creation of the object members. This is known as memory allocation for object.

mcqs.question: Where is the memory allocated for the objects?
mcqs.explanation: The memory for the objects or any other data is allocated in RAM initially. This is while we run a program all the memory allocation takes place in some RAM segments. Arrays in heap and local members in stack etc.

mcqs.question: When is the memory allocated for an object?

options.c: c) When object constructor is called
options.d: d) When object is initialized to another object

mcqs.answer: c) When object constructor is called
mcqs.explanation: The object memory allocation takes place when the object constructor is called. Declaration of an object doesn’t mean that memory is allocated for its members. If object is initialized with another object, it may just get a reference to the previously created object.

mcqs.question: Using new is type safe as _______________________

options.a: a) It require to be specified with type of data
options.b: b) It doesn’t require to be specified with type of data
options.c: c) It requires the name of data
options.d: d) It allocated memory for the data

mcqs.answer: b) It doesn’t require to be specified with type of data
mcqs.explanation: The new is type safe because we don’t have to specify the type of data that have to be allocated with memory. We can directly use it with data name. Name of the data doesn’t matter though for type of memory allocation though.

mcqs.question: Which of the following function can be used for dynamic memory allocation of objects?
mcqs.explanation: The malloc() function can be used to allocate dynamic memory for objects. Function calloc() can also be use. These functions differ in the way they allocate memory for objects.

mcqs.question:
How much memory will be allocated for an object of class given below? 
class Test
{
	int mark1;
	int mark2;
	float avg;
	char name[10];
};
mcqs.explanation: The size of an object of the class given in question will be of size 22 bytes. This is because the size of an object is always equal to the sum of sizes of the data members of the class, except static members.

mcqs.question: Which keyword among the following can be used to declare an array of objects in java?
mcqs.explanation: The keyword new can be used to declare an array of objects in java. The syntax must be specified with an object pointer which is assigned with a memory space containing the required number of object space. Even initialization can be done directly.

mcqs.question: When is the memory allocated for an object gets free?

options.b: b) When object goes out of scope

mcqs.answer: b) When object goes out of scope
mcqs.explanation: Whenever an object goes out of scope, the deletion of allocation memory takes place. Actually the data is not deleted, instead the memory space is flagged to be free for further use. Hence whenever an object goes out of scope the object members become useless and hence memory is set free.

mcqs.question: Which among the following keyword can be used to free the allocated memory for an object?
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocated for an object is usually automatically made free. But if explicitly memory has to be made free then we can use either free or delete keywords depending on programming languages.

mcqs.question: Which function is called whenever an object goes out of scope?
mcqs.explanation: The destructor function of the class is called whenever an object goes out of scope. This is because the destructor set all the resources, acquired by the object, free. This is an implicit work of compiler.

mcqs.question: Which operator can be used to check the size of an object?
mcqs.explanation: The sizeof operator is used to get the size of an already created object. This operator must constail keyword sizeof(objectName). The output will give the number of bytes acquired by a single object of some class.

mcqs.question: The memory allocated for an object ____________________

options.c: c) Can be static or dynamic
options.d: d) Can’t be done using dynamic functions

mcqs.answer: c) Can be static or dynamic
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocation for an object can be static or dynamic. The static memory allocation is when an object is declared directly without using any function usually. And dynamic allocation is when we use some dynamic allocation function to allocate memory for data member of an object.

mcqs.question: If an object is declared in a user defined function __________________

options.a: a) Its memory is allocated in stack
options.b: b) Its memory is allocated in heap
options.c: c) Its memory is allocated in HDD
options.d: d) Its memory is allocated in cache

mcqs.answer: a) Its memory is allocated in stack
mcqs.explanation: The memory for any data or object that are used in a user defined function are always allocated in the stack. This is to ensure that the object is destroyed as soon as the function is returned. Also this ensures that the correct memory allocation and destruction is performed.

mcqs.question: In java, ____________________ takes care of managing memory for objects dynamically.
mcqs.explanation: The garbage collector in java takes care of the memory allocations and their deletions dynamically. When an object is no more required then the garbage collector deletes the object and free up all the resources that were held by that object.

mcqs.question: Which operator can be used to free the memory allocated for an object in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator in C++ can be used to free the memory and resources held by an object. The function can be called explicitly whenever required. In C++ memory management must be done by the programmer. There is no automatic memory management in C++.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Object Array”.

mcqs.question: What is an array of objects?

options.a: a) An array of instances of class represented by single name
options.b: b) An array of instances of class represented by more than one name
options.c: c) An array of instances which have more than 2 instances
options.d: d) An array of instances which have different types

mcqs.answer: a) An array of instances of class represented by single name
mcqs.explanation: The array of objects an array of instances of a class. The array is represented by a single name. The array name is itself a pointer. Array name represents the first object.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a mandatory condition for array of objects?

options.a: a) All the objects should be of different class
options.b: b) All the objects should be of same program classes
options.c: c) All the objects should be of same class
options.d: d) All the objects should have different data

mcqs.answer: c) All the objects should be of same class
mcqs.explanation: The objects of an array must be of same class. This is mandatory because array is set of same type of elements. The objects of same class are considered to be of same type.

mcqs.question: What is the type of elements of array of objects?
mcqs.explanation: The class itself is the type of elements of array of objects. All the objects possess the same properties. Like any other primitive data type, the objects are of their respective class type.

mcqs.question:
If array of objects is declared as given below, which is the limitation on objects? 
Class_name arrayName[size];

options.a: a) The objects will have same values
options.b: b) The objects will not be initialized individually
options.c: c) The objects can never be initialized
options.d: d) The objects will have same data

mcqs.answer: b) The objects will not be initialized individually
mcqs.explanation: If the syntax given, is used to declare the array of objects, then the objects can’t be initialized individually. All the objects will have to be initialized after this declaration.

mcqs.question: Which is the condition that must be followed if the array of objects is declared without initialization, only with size of array?

options.a: a) The class should have separate constructor for each object
options.b: b) The class must have no constructors
options.c: c) The class should not have any member function
options.d: d) The class must have a default or zero argument constructor

mcqs.answer: d) The class must have a default or zero argument constructor
mcqs.explanation: The class must have a default/zero argument constructor. Since the declaration is done by only specifying the size of array, the class must have default a construct to be called by default to reserve memory for each object. Also, we can’t specify the arguments in this type of declaration hence the class should provide a default initialization.

mcqs.question: When are the array of objects without any initialization useful?

options.a: a) When object data is not required just after the declaration
options.b: b) When initialization of object data is to be made by the compiler
options.c: c) When object data doesn’t matter in the program
options.d: d) When the object should contain garbage data

mcqs.answer: a) When object data is not required just after the declaration
mcqs.explanation: Sometimes the object data is not mandatory to be used just after the declaration or may be the program requires the data to be updated according to what user inputs. Hence only declaration us also useful.

mcqs.question: If constructor arguments are passed to objects of array then ____________ if the constructors are overloaded.

options.a: a) It is mandatory to pass same number of arguments to all the objects
options.b: b) It is mandatory to pass same type of arguments to all the objects
options.c: c) It is not mandatory to call same constructor for all the objects
options.d: d) It is mandatory to call same constructor for all the constructors

mcqs.answer: c) It is not mandatory to call same constructor for all the objects
mcqs.explanation: It is not mandatory to call the same constructor for all the objects in an array if initialized with the declaration. The objects can be passed with different set of arguments in the same syntax, separated by commas.

mcqs.question: How the objects of array can be denoted?
mcqs.explanation: Different objects in an array can be denoted with the indices of array. The first object is denoted by 0. And the further indices denote the next objects in sequence of array.

mcqs.question: The objects in an object array _______________________

options.a: a) Can be created without use of constructor
options.b: b) Can be created without calling default constructor
options.c: c) Can’t be created with use of constructor
options.d: d) Can’t be created without calling default constructor

mcqs.answer: b) Can be created without calling default constructor
mcqs.explanation: The objects need some constructor to get the memory spaced reserved for those. If the default constructor is not used then we can use some arguments constructor which will reserve the memory for the objects. The objects can be passed with constructor arguments during declaration.

mcqs.question: The Object array is created in _____________________
mcqs.explanation: If the object arrays are declared dynamically, then the memory will be reserved on heap. The memory for objects will be on stack only if some constructor or some call and return tasks are happening. The program doesn’t run on HDD and ROM is not used for the execution of programs.

mcqs.question: If an array of objects is of size 10 and a data value have to be retrieved from 5th object then ________________ syntax should be used.
mcqs.explanation: The array name with the index of fifth element is called, i.e. index 4. Then the dot operator is used to access the data member of that object. This Allows us to access the data members of all the objects in an object array.

mcqs.question: Can we have two dimensional object array?

options.b: b) Yes, only if primitive type array
options.c: c) No, since two indices are impossible

mcqs.explanation: A two dimensional array can always be created. There is no rule that only primitive type objects can have more than one dimension. The object array can also be made 2 dimensional.

mcqs.question: From which index does the array of objects start?
mcqs.explanation: The index must start from 0. The index ends at size – 1 index. This is because the index is always till n-1 where n is the total number of beads.

mcqs.question: Two dimensional array can’t be initialized with the declaration.
mcqs.explanation: The two dimensional arrays can also be initialized using curly brackets. For each set, values in curly bracket. And then another bracket is added at first and end. This ensures that all the code belongs to the user.

mcqs.question: Is an array of characters always a string?

options.b: b) Yes, if each character is terminated by null
options.c: c) No, since each character is terminated by null

mcqs.explanation: The character arrays are not the same as string. The string once created then remains the same. The character array values may change.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming using C++ MCQs focuses on “Object Use”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the main use of object?

options.a: a) To create instance of a function
options.b: b) To create instance of a program
options.c: c) To create instance of class
options.d: d) To create instance of structures

mcqs.answer: c) To create instance of class
mcqs.explanation: The objects are used to create an instance of a class. Objects can represent a class in an independent form. The basic blueprint, that contains the information of the type of data that can be stored in an object, is given by the class.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is not a property of an object?
mcqs.explanation: The names are not property of an object. The identity can be in any form like address or name of object but name can’t be termed as only identity of an object. The objects contain attributes that define what type of data an object can store.

mcqs.question: What is function object?

options.a: a) An object with a single function
options.b: b) An object with only functions
options.c: c) An object with more than one function
options.d: d) An object with no functions

mcqs.answer: a) An object with a single function
mcqs.explanation: A function object is an object with single function. In C++ a function object can be like operator() function. This acts more like a function rather than an object.

mcqs.question: Immutable object are used ______________________

options.a: a) To set up as a fixed state
options.b: b) To set up variable object
options.c: c) To set up an object of abstract class
options.d: d) To set up an object of derived class

mcqs.answer: a) To set up as a fixed state
mcqs.explanation: An immutable object can be created for an object which has to be fixed with values. The object data will not be changed throughout the program. This can be useful to eliminate the unintentional changes in the data of object.

mcqs.question: Which object can be used to contain other objects?
mcqs.explanation: A container object can be used to contain other objects. Container object is an ADT. Its object are collection of other objects. Some specific rules apply to these types of objects.

mcqs.question: A factory object is used ______________________

options.c: c) To create new data members

mcqs.explanation: The factory object is an object that can be used to create other objects. If it is seen formally, it behaves like a method that will return object on its use. The object returned is assumed to be a new object.

mcqs.question: What are singleton objects?

options.a: a) The only two objects of a class throughout the program
options.b: b) The only object of a class throughout the program
options.c: c) The objects that are alive throughout the program
options.d: d) The objects that are created and then deleted without use

mcqs.answer: b) The only object of a class throughout the program
mcqs.explanation: If a class has only one object created and that is the only object of the class. Then the object is known as the singleton object. But only if that object is the only object of the class and no other object is created for that class.

mcqs.question: Object cout and cin _________________

options.a: a) Can be used directly with << and >> symbols respectively
options.b: b) Can be used directly with >> and << symbols respectively
options.c: c) Must be used as a function which accepts 2 arguments
options.d: d) Must be used as a function which accepts 3 arguments

mcqs.answer: a) Can be used directly with << and >> symbols respectively
mcqs.explanation: The cin and cout objects can be used directly with the >> and << operators respectively. The objects are of iostream class. Class iostream is an inbuilt class.

mcqs.question: Objects type ____________________

options.a: a) Can be changed in runtime
options.b: b) Can’t be changed in runtime
options.c: c) Can be changed in compile time
options.d: d) May or may not get changed

mcqs.answer: b) Can’t be changed in runtime
mcqs.explanation: The object types are always fixed. Once the object is created of a specific type then it can’t be changed. Neither at runtime nor at compile time.

mcqs.question: An object can be used to represent _________________
mcqs.explanation: The objects are actually meant to represent an entity. The classes are real world object’s blueprint. The classes then are used to create an entity representation.

mcqs.question: Objects can be used _____________________

options.a: a) To access any member of a class
options.b: b) To access only public members of a class
options.c: c) To access only protected members of a class
options.d: d) To access only private members of a class

mcqs.answer: b) To access only public members of a class
mcqs.explanation: The objects are created for a specific class. Then the objects can be used to access the public members of a class. The members can be the data members or the member functions of the class.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is not a use of object?

options.c: c) Creating instance of a class

mcqs.explanation: The objects can’t be used to define any member function. Member functions must be defined by the class only. Objects can only access the members and use them.

mcqs.question: Which object can be used to access the standard input?
mcqs.explanation: Object cin can be used to take input from the standard input. It is used in C++. In java we can use System.in for the standard input stream. The syntax changes from language to language.

mcqs.question: A single object can be used __________________

options.a: a) As only two class types at a time
options.b: b) As only three class types at a time
options.c: c) As only one class type at a time
options.d: d) As of as many class types as required

mcqs.answer: c) As only one class type at a time
mcqs.explanation: The object can be of only one type. The type of an object can’t be changed. Object type is mandatory to be of one class type to ensure the type and number of data members it have.

mcqs.question: If same object name is given to different objects of different class then _____________
mcqs.explanation: It is a compile time error as the compiler doesn’t allow the same name objects to be declared more than once. Compiler produces multiple declaration errors. Every object must have a different name.

title: 6. Object Oriented Programming MCQ on Classes

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Abstract Class
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Abstract Class”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following best describes abstract classes?

options.a: a) If a class has more than one virtual function, it’s abstract class
options.b: b) If a class have only one pure virtual function, it’s abstract class
options.c: c) If a class has at least one pure virtual function, it’s abstract class
options.d: d) If a class has all the pure virtual functions only, then it’s abstract class

mcqs.answer: c) If a class has at least one pure virtual function, it’s abstract class
mcqs.explanation: The condition for a class to be called abstract class is that it must have at least one pure virtual function. The keyword abstract must be used while defining abstract class in java.

mcqs.question: Can abstract class have main() function defined inside it?

options.a: a) Yes, depending on return type of main()
options.c: c) No, main must not be defined inside abstract class
options.d: d) No, because main() is not abstract function

mcqs.explanation: This is a property of abstract class. It can define main() function inside it. There is no restriction on its definition and implementation.

mcqs.question: If there is an abstract method in a class then, ________________

options.a: a) Class must be abstract class
options.b: b) Class may or may not be abstract class

mcqs.answer: a) Class must be abstract class
mcqs.explanation: It is a rule that if a class have even one abstract method, it must be an abstract class. If this rule was not made, the abstract methods would have got skipped to get defined in some places which are undesirable with the idea of abstract class.

mcqs.question: If a class is extending/inheriting another abstract class having abstract method, then _______________________

options.a: a) Either implementation of method or making class abstract is mandatory
options.b: b) Implementation of the method in derived class is mandatory
options.c: c) Making the derived class also abstract is mandatory
options.d: d) It’s not mandatory to implement the abstract method of parent class

mcqs.answer: a) Either implementation of method or making class abstract is mandatory
mcqs.explanation: Either of the two things must be done, either implementation or declaration of class as abstract. This is done to ensure that the method intended to be defined by other classes gets defined at every possible class.

mcqs.question: Abstract class A has 4 virtual functions. Abstract class B defines only 2 of those member functions as it extends class A. Class C extends class B and implements the other two member functions of class A. Choose the correct option below.

options.a: a) Program won’t run as all the methods are not defined by B
options.b: b) Program won’t run as C is not inheriting A directly
options.c: c) Program won’t run as multiple inheritance is used

mcqs.explanation: The program runs correctly. This is because even class B is abstract so it’s not mandatory to define all the virtual functions. Class C is not abstract but all the virtual functions have been implemented will that class.

mcqs.question: Abstract classes can ____________________ instances.
mcqs.explanation: When an abstract class is defined, it won’t be having the implementation of at least one function. This will restrict the class to have any constructor. When the class doesn’t have constructor, there won’t be any instance of that class.

mcqs.question: We ___________________ to an abstract class.

options.c: c) Can create pointers or references
options.d: d) Can’t create any reference, pointer or instance

mcqs.answer: c) Can create pointers or references
mcqs.explanation: Even though there can’t be any instance of abstract class. We can always create pointer or reference to abstract class. The member functions which have some implementation inside abstract itself can be used with these references.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is an important use of abstract classes?
mcqs.explanation: The abstract classes can be used to create a generic, extensible class library that can be used by other programmers. This helps us to get some already implemented codes and functions that might have not been provided by the programming language itself.

mcqs.question: Use of pointers or reference to an abstract class gives rise to which among the following feature?
mcqs.explanation: The runtime polymorphism is supported by reference and pointer to an abstract class. This relies upon base class pointer and reference to select the proper virtual function.

mcqs.question: The abstract classes in java can _________________

options.c: c) Can implement only unimplemented methods
options.d: d) Can’t implement any type of constructor

mcqs.explanation: The abstract classes in java can define a constructor. Even though instance can’t be created. But in this way, only during constructor chaining, constructor can be called. When instance of concrete implementation class is created, it’s known as constructor chaining.

mcqs.question: Abstract class can’t be final in java.
mcqs.explanation: If an abstract class is made final in java, it will stop the abstract class from being extended. And if the class is not getting extended, there won’t be another class to implement the virtual functions. Due to this contradicting fact, it can’t be final in java.

mcqs.question: Can abstract classes have static methods (Java)?

options.b: b) Yes, but depends on code
options.d: d) No, static members can’t have different values

mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction on declaring static methods. The only condition is that the virtual functions must have some definition in the program.

mcqs.question: It is _________________________ to have an abstract method.

options.a: a) Not mandatory for an static class
options.b: b) Not mandatory for a derived class
options.c: c) Not mandatory for an abstract class
options.d: d) Not mandatory for parent class

mcqs.answer: c) Not mandatory for an abstract class
mcqs.explanation: Derived, parent and static classes can’t have abstract method (We can’t say what type of these classes is). And for abstract class it’s not mandatory to have abstract method. But if any abstract method is there inside a class, then class must be abstract type.

mcqs.question: How many abstract classes can a single program contain?
mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction on the number of abstract classes that can be defined inside a single program. The programs can use as many abstract classes as required. But the functions with no body must be implemented.

mcqs.question: Is it necessary that all the abstract methods must be defined from an abstract class?

options.d: d) No, if function is not used, no definition is required

mcqs.explanation: That is the rule of programming language that each function declared, must have some definition. There can’t be some abstract method that remains undefined. Even if it’s there, it would result in compile time error.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Template Class
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Template Class”.

mcqs.question: A template class can have _____________

options.a: a) More than one generic data type
options.b: b) Only one generic data type
options.c: c) At most two data types
options.d: d) Only generic type of integers and not characters

mcqs.answer: a) More than one generic data type
mcqs.explanation: The template class can support more than one data type. The only thing is to add all the data types required in a list separated by comma within template specification.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the proper syntax for the template class?

options.c: c) template <typename T> T named(T x, T y){  }
options.d: d) Template <typename T1, typename T2> T1 named(T1 x, T2 y){  }

mcqs.answer: c) template <typename T> T named(T x, T y){  }
mcqs.explanation: The syntax must start with keyword template, case sensitive. Then it should include the typename and a variable to denote it. Then whenever that variable is used, it replaces it with the data type needed.

mcqs.question: Can default arguments be used with the template class?

options.a: a) Yes, in some special cases
options.c: c) No, it must satisfy some specific conditions first
options.d: d) No, it can’t be done

mcqs.explanation: The template class can use default arguments. This is used to specify the data type to be considered if it is not specified while passing to the generic class. The default type will be used.

mcqs.question: What is the syntax to use explicit class specialization?
mcqs.explanation: The class specialization is creation of explicit specialization of a generic class. We have to use template<> constructor for this to work. It works in the same way as with explicit function specialization.

mcqs.question: Which is the most significant feature that arises by using template classes?
mcqs.explanation: The code reusability is the feature that becomes more powerful with the use of template classes. You can generate a single code that can be used in variety of programming situations.

mcqs.question: A template class defines the form of a class _____________________ it will operate.

options.a: a) With full specification of the data on which
options.b: b) With full specification of the functions on which
options.c: c) Without full specification of the data on which
options.d: d) Without full specification of the functions on which

mcqs.answer: c) Without full specification of the data on which
mcqs.explanation: The template classes can accept all types of data types. There is no need to specify the data on which the class has to operate. Hence it gives us flexibility to code without worrying about the type of data that might be used in the code.

mcqs.question: What are the two specializations of I/O template classes in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The I/O specialization is made with wide character and 8-bit characters. Wide characters are used to store the characters that might take more than 1 byte of space in memory or any size that is different from the one that the machine is using.

mcqs.question: Can typeid() function be used with the object of generic classes?

options.a: a) Yes, only if default type is given
options.c: c) No, generic data can’t be determined

mcqs.explanation: The typeid() function can be used with the objects of generic classes. An instance of a template class will take the type of data that is being used with it. Hence when typeid() function is used, the data type would have already been defined and hence we can get desired result from typeid() function.

mcqs.question: The _____________ class is a specialization of a more general template class.
mcqs.explanation: The string class is more specialized. Since the string must be able to store any kind of data that is given to the string. Hence it needs maximum specialization.

mcqs.question: How is function overloading different from template class?

options.a: a) Overloading is multiple function doing same operation, Template is multiple function doing different operations
options.b: b) Overloading is single function doing different operations, Template is multiple function doing different operations
options.c: c) Overloading is multiple function doing similar operation, Template is multiple function doing identical operations
options.d: d) Overloading is multiple function doing same operation, Template is same function doing different operations

mcqs.answer: c) Overloading is multiple function doing similar operation, Template is multiple function doing identical operations
mcqs.explanation: The function overloading is multiple functions with similar or different functionality but generic class functions perform the same task on given different types of data.

mcqs.question: What if static members are declared inside template classes?

options.a: a) All instances will share the static variable
options.b: b) All instances will have their own static variable
options.c: c) All the instances will ignore the static variable
options.d: d) Program gives compile time error

mcqs.answer: b) All instances will have their own static variable
mcqs.explanation: The generic class have a special case with static members. Each instance will have its own static member. The static members are not shared usually.

mcqs.question:
What is the output of following program? 
template <typename T>
void test(const T&x) 
{
    static int count = 0;
    cout << "x = " << x << " count = " << count << endl;
    ++count;
    return;
}
 
void main() 
{
    test<int> (2);
    test<int>(2);
    test<double>(2.2);
}

options.a:
a)
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2.2 count = 0
x = 2.2 count = 0
options.b:
b)
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2.2 count = 0
options.c:
c)
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2 count = 1
x = 2.2 count = 0
options.d:
d)
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2 count = 1
x = 2.2 count = 2

mcqs.answer:
c)
x = 2 count = 0
x = 2 count = 1
x = 2.2 count = 0
mcqs.explanation: For each new type, the class will have separate instance. Here two instances will be created and hence counter for integer goes to 1. And for float value, the count remains 0 for the output.

mcqs.question: If template class is defined, is it necessary to use different types of data for each call?

options.b: b) No, but at least two types must be there
options.c: c) Yes, to make proper use of template

mcqs.explanation: It is not necessary to use different type with each call to the generic function. Data may be of same type with each call but still the function works. We don’t consider other properties like efficiency with this concept because it is made generic to all data type, hence always works.

mcqs.question: How many generic types can be given inside a single template class?
mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction on the number of types to be used for making the class generic. There can be any number of generic types with a single class. Hence giving flexibility to code with all the data types.

mcqs.question: Template classes must have at least one static member.
mcqs.explanation: There is no mandatory condition to have static members inside template class. Not only template, it is not mandatory to have static members anywhere. We can use them as required in the code.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Base Class
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Base Class”.

mcqs.question: Which is most appropriate definition of a base class?

options.a: a) It is parent of any of its derived class
options.b: b) It is child of one of the parent class
options.c: c) It is most basic class of whole program
options.d: d) It is class with maximum number of members

mcqs.answer: a) It is parent of any of its derived class
mcqs.explanation: A class which is parent of another class, or from which other classes can be derived, is known as a base class. It is mandatory that a class must have at least one derived class to be called as a base class.

mcqs.question: A base class is also known as _____________ class.
mcqs.explanation: A class which is being derived by other classes, is called as super class. This concept is clearly used in java as we call the functions of a base class by using the keyword super as required.

mcqs.question: An abstract class is always a __________ class.
mcqs.explanation: Every abstract class is a base class. It must be so, because the functions which are not defined inside the abstract class, must be defined in the derived classes. Hence it becomes a base class.

mcqs.question: How many base classes can a single class inherit in java?
mcqs.explanation: In java, multiple inheritance is not supported, which leads to the fact that a class can have only 1 parent class if inheritance is used. Only if interfaces are used then the class can implement more than one base class.

mcqs.question: How to make a derived class a base class?

options.a: a) Change name of the class
options.c: c) Make a class derive from it

mcqs.answer: c) Make a class derive from it
mcqs.explanation: Making another class derive from it will make that class as base class. It is not necessary that we have to write different code for it. If at least one class derives that class, it becomes the base class for the new class.

mcqs.question: If a base class is being derived by two other classes, which inheritance will that be called?
mcqs.explanation: When more than one classes are being derived from a single parent class, the inheritance is known as hierarchical inheritance. This is usually useful when the base class is higher abstraction of its derived classes.

mcqs.question: Which among the following must be in a base class?
mcqs.explanation: Even a class that doesn’t have any members can be a base class. It is not mandatory to have any member or attribute in base class.

mcqs.question: Which type of members can’t be accessed in derived classes of a base class?
mcqs.explanation: The private members can be accessed only inside the base class. If the class is derived by other classes. Those members will not be accessible. This concept of OOP is made to make the members more secure.

mcqs.question: If a class is enclosing more than one class, than it can be called as base class of those classes.
mcqs.explanation: When a class have more than one nested classes, it is known as enclosing class. It can’t be called as parent or base class since there is no inheritance involved.

mcqs.question: Base class have ________________ of abstraction.
mcqs.explanation: A base class will have lesser information as compared to those of derived classes. Since derived classes inherit the base class properties and then add on their own features, they elaborate more hence have lower degree of abstraction.

mcqs.question: Always the base class constructors are called ___________ constructor of derived class.
mcqs.explanation: When the base class object is created, its constructor will be called for sure. But if a derived class constructor is called, first base class constructor is called and then derived class constructor is taken into consideration.

mcqs.question: Can we call methods of base class using the constructor of the derived class?

options.d: d) No, but we can call in some cases

mcqs.explanation: If the function is defined in the base class, it can always be called from the constructor of its derived class. Since the constructors are not private, they can be accessed in derived class even if those are protected.

mcqs.question: If a base class is inherited from another class and then one class derives it, which inheritance is shown?
mcqs.explanation: If a base class is inherited from another class, single inheritance is shown. But when one more class inherits the derived class, this becomes a multi-level inheritance.

mcqs.question: How many base classes can a single derived class have in C++?
mcqs.explanation: This is because C++ allows multiple inheritance. A derived class can have more than one base class and hence can derive all of their features.

mcqs.question: If a base class is added with a few new members, its subclass must also be modified.
mcqs.explanation: The base class can be added with new members without affecting the subclasses. This is because the subclasses may get some more features inherited but it won’t use them. But the base class will be able to use the new members as would be required.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Derived Class
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Derived Class”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is best definition of a derived class?

options.b: b) A class which inherits one or more classes
options.c: c) A class with keyword derived
options.d: d) A class with more than one constructor

mcqs.answer: b) A class which inherits one or more classes
mcqs.explanation: Any class which inherits one or more classes is a derived class. The only condition is it must inherit at least one class in order to be called as a derived class.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is inherited by a derived class from base class?

options.c: c) All the members except private members
options.d: d) All the members of base class

mcqs.answer: c) All the members except private members
mcqs.explanation: The class inheriting another class, inherits all the data members and member functions that are not private. This is done to ensure the security features with maximum flexibility.

mcqs.question: If there is a derived class in a program, how many classes must be in that program?
mcqs.explanation: If there is a derived class in a program, there must be at least 2 classes in that program. One is a base class and another derived class. Hence at least 2 classes must be there.

mcqs.question: Which members can never be accessed in derived class from the base class?
mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction for a derived class to access the members of the base class until and unless the members are private. Private member are declared so that those members are not accessible outside the class.

mcqs.question: How many types of inheritance are supported in C++ for deriving a class?
mcqs.explanation: There are three types of inheritance possible. Private inheritance, protected inheritance, and public inheritance. The inheritance defines the access specifier to be used with the inherited members in the derived class.

mcqs.question: How many derived class can a single base class have?
mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction on how many classes can inherit a single base class. Hence there can be as many derived classes as required in a program from a single base class.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is correct?

options.a: a) Friend function of derived class can access non-private members of base class
options.b: b) Friend function of base class can access derived class members
options.c: c) Friend function of derived class can access members of only derived class
options.d: d) Friend function can access private members of base class of a derived class

mcqs.answer: a) Friend function of derived class can access non-private members of base class
mcqs.explanation: The friend function of a class can access the non-private members of base class. The reason behind is that the members of base class gets derived into the derived class and hence become members of derived class too. Hence a friend function can access all of those.

mcqs.question: If a class is being derived using more than two base classes, which inheritance will be used?
mcqs.explanation: The statement given is the definition of multiple inheritance with respect to the derived class. The concept can be illustrated with many other samples but the main aspects are base class and derived class only.

mcqs.question: Derived class is also known as ______________ class.
mcqs.explanation: It is just another name given to the derived classes. This is used while denoting all the derived classes subsequent to a superclass.

mcqs.question: If class A is derived from another derived class B which is derived from class C, which class will have maximum level of abstraction?

options.d: d) All have the same level of abstraction

mcqs.explanation: The abstraction level of class C will be maximum. This is because the parent class have higher level of abstraction. Hence the parent of all other class will have maximum level of abstraction.

mcqs.question: If base class is an abstract class then derived class ______________ the undefined functions.

options.b: b) Must become another abstract class or define
options.c: c) Must become parent class for

mcqs.answer: b) Must become another abstract class or define
mcqs.explanation: The function must be defined in the program which are not defined in the base class. Hence the class must be defined as abstract of implement the function definition in it.

mcqs.question: How many classes can be derived from a derived class?
mcqs.explanation: When a class is to be derived from another derived class, the derived class behaves as a normal base class hence there are no restriction on how many class can be derived from a derived class. The derived class again behaves as a normal superclass.

mcqs.question: The members of a derived class can never be derived.
mcqs.explanation: This is not true that the members of a derived class can’t be derived. All the classes are considered to be a normal class when used for derivation. The members can be derived with respect to their access specifiers.

mcqs.question: Which feature is not related to the derived classes among the following?
mcqs.explanation: The memory management is the feature that is not necessary for derived classes that will be a part of whole program. The functions references must be resolved for their proper use if inheritance is used.

mcqs.question: Deriving a class in such a way that that the base class members are not available for further inheritance is known as ___________________
mcqs.explanation: The private members of a class can never be derived to another class. When a class derives another class using private inheritance, all the members become private members of the derived class. Hence these member won’t be available for further inheritance.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Class Use
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Class Use”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the main characteristic of class?
mcqs.explanation: The classes are made to encapsulate the data and properties that are most similar and can be grouped together inside a single class. This single class can represent all of those features by creating its instances.

mcqs.question: To group all the brands of cars, what should be used?
mcqs.explanation: A class can be used to group all the brands of cars. The Different brands may have different properties but all will have some common properties like number of wheels and doors, accessories etc. All of those properties can be grouped into a single class representing all the cars.

mcqs.question: If a class have two data members and two functions to add those two numbers and to subtract them, which among the following is most efficient if the programmer wants to implement multiplication too?

options.a: a) Define a public function which multiplies two numbers
options.b: b) Define a public function that returns values of two data members
options.c: c) Define a private function which multiplies two numbers
options.d: d) Define a private function that returns values of two data members

mcqs.answer: b) Define a public function that returns values of two data members
mcqs.explanation: The best choice would be to define a public member function that returns the values of two data members of the class. This way we can implement any operation on those data members. Also there won’t be any need to modify the program and to add new functions for each new operation.

mcqs.question: If a database have to be maintained using OOP, to store the details of each employee in a company, which would be the best choice among the following?

options.a: a) Define a class to store details of each employee
options.b: b) Define a structure to store details of each employee
options.c: c) Define separate variable for each detail
options.d: d) Define a generic type to store string and number details

mcqs.answer: a) Define a class to store details of each employee
mcqs.explanation: A single class can be defined that represents a single employee of a company. The specific type of functions that can be applied to specific employees can be put into another class that is derived from the existing class.

mcqs.question: Which class represents the most abstracted information?
mcqs.explanation: The base classes are the most abstracted part of information. A base class having many other derived classes would have a bigger overview of all the other derived classes. Hence the base classes have the most abstract information.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is an advantage of using classes over structures of C?

options.c: c) Functions can also be encapsulated
options.d: d) Functions can have more security

mcqs.answer: c) Functions can also be encapsulated
mcqs.explanation: The functions are also made easy to be encapsulated inside a class. In structures, only the data members were allowed to be encapsulated. Hence classes can represent an entity in a better way.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a feature of class?

options.c: c) Both object and procedure orientation
options.d: d) Neither object nor procedure orientation

mcqs.explanation: Thee use of classes feature the object oriented programming. The OOP concept can be implemented by using class and their objects. Procedures orientation is not a feature of OOP.

mcqs.question: Class is _____________ of an object.
mcqs.explanation: The class is an overview for an object. It contains the basic details map of data that an object will contain. An object is independent representation of class.

mcqs.question: In which case the classes can be used to make the more efficient program?

options.a: a) To define a function that is called frequently in a program
options.b: b) To structure data that is most similar
options.c: c) To group the most similar data and operations
options.d: d) To define a blueprint that shows memory location of data

mcqs.answer: c) To group the most similar data and operations
mcqs.explanation: The classes would be more suitable to use in case where we need to group the most similar data and operations. The data can be represented as data members of class and operations as member functions of class. This is indirectly encapsulation feature.

mcqs.question: What is the use of inbuilt classes?

options.c: c) Provide predefined data and functions
options.d: d) Provide predeclared data to be overridden

mcqs.answer: c) Provide predefined data and functions
mcqs.explanation: The data that is constant or is always the same initially for use can be provided by some inbuilt classes. The functions that are mostly used are also provided by the inbuilt classes. The data and functions can be used by including the corresponding header file or library.

mcqs.question: Which feature is exhibited by the inbuilt classes?

options.d: d) Code reusability, efficiency and readability

mcqs.answer: d) Code reusability, efficiency and readability
mcqs.explanation: The code is reusable as the functions which are already written, can be used anytime required. The code becomes easier to read. Also, the code is efficient as there is no need to assign any external code.

mcqs.question: Why do we use user defined classes?

options.a: a) To design a user intended code
options.b: b) To model real world objects

mcqs.answer: b) To model real world objects
mcqs.explanation: The primitive classes are not sufficient for the programming complex algorithms. Some user defined classes are required to represent a real world object and to define a blueprint of what the class should actually contain. The user defined classes are as per the requirements and need of user.

mcqs.question: Why do classes use accessor methods?

options.a: a) To make public data accessible to client
options.b: b) To make public data private to client
options.c: c) To make private data public for whole program
options.d: d) To make private data accessible to the client

mcqs.answer: d) To make private data accessible to the client
mcqs.explanation: The private data of a class is usually not accessible. But the data can be accessed by the user using accessor functions. These functions allows the user to get the data stored as private in a class.

mcqs.question: Why do classes use mutator methods?

options.a: a) Allows client to modify the program
options.b: b) Allows client to modify/write the private members
options.c: c) Allows servers to access all the private data
options.d: d) Allows servers to access only protected members

mcqs.answer: b) Allows client to modify/write the private members
mcqs.explanation: The client can have rights to access a file and write something to it. This is mandatory to keep the private data updated. Also it is an advantage over the use of hidden class members.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the most abstract form of class?
mcqs.explanation: The most abstract class is class Cars. The class Cars is the most general form of all other cars. If it is a brand of car, it comes under car. If it is the type of car then also it comes under Cars.

title: 7. OOPs Multiple Choice Questions on Class Components (Using Java)

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using Java Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Data Members”.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Books
{
    abstract int price;
    Books(int p)
    {
        this.price = p;
    }
    public void getPrice()
    {
        System.out.println("Price: "+this.price);
    }
}
public class AbstractDataMembers
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Books b = new Books(20);
        b.getPrice();
    }
}
mcqs.explanation:
An abstract modifier in java is a non-access modifier which can only be applied to classes and methods but not for variables. In the program, we marked the instance data member “price” as an abstract, so we get a compilation error.
Output:

$ javac AbstractDataMembers.java
error: modifier abstract not allowed here.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
import java.io.*;
class TransientVariables implements Serializable
{
    int num1 = 20;
    transient int num2 = 30;
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        TransientVariables t = new TransientVariables();
        FileOutputStream fo = new FileOutputStream("input.txt");
        ObjectOutputStream oo = new ObjectOutputStream(fo);
        oo.writeObject(t);
        FileInputStream fi = new FileInputStream("input.txt");
        ObjectInputStream oi = new ObjectInputStream(fi);
        TransientVariables t1 = (TransientVariables) oi.readObject();
        System.out.println("num1: " + t1.num1);
        System.out.println("num2: " + t1.num2);
    }
}
mcqs.explanation:
Instance data members can be transient in java. In the program, we declared the instance data member “num2” as transient. The transient keyword makes the JVM ignore the original value of the variable “num2” (20) at the time of serialization and saves the default value of the variable’s data type. As “num2” is an integer, it saves 0 as default value.
Output:

$ javac TransientVariables.java
$ java TransientVariables
20
0

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
//Create a directory/folder named p1, and save a Java file(Vehicle.java)
package p1; 
public class Vehicle
{
    protected int color;
    protected int speed = 10;
}
//Create another directory named p2, and save a Java file(ProtectedVariables.java) and make sure that two packages should be under the same root directory.
//another program
package p2;
import p1.Vehicle; //import package p1
public class ProtectedVariables extends Vehicle
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        ProtectedVariables p = new ProtectedVariables();
        System.out.println("Speed: "+p.speed);
    }
}
mcqs.explanation:
We can access the Protected modifiers outside the package by using Inheritance. In the program, we have accessed the protected variable “speed” outside the package (p1) by importing the package(p1) in p2.
Output:

$ javac -cp . p1\Vehicle.java p2\ProtectedVariables.java
$ java -cp . p2.ProtectedVariables
Speed: 10

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Book
{
    String title;
    String author;
    Book(String t)
    {
        this.title = t;
    }
}
public class InstanceMembers
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Book b = new Book("Java Programming");
        System.out.println("Book Title: "+Book.title);
    }
}
mcqs.explanation:
An instance variable is accessed using the respective object name. In the program, we are accessing it by calling the class name, so we get an error. Instance data members are also known as “Object Level Data Members” because they depend on object names instead of class names.
Output:

$ javac InstanceMembers.java
error: non-static variable title cannot be referenced from a static context.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Employee
{
    int salary = 1000000;
    static float experience = 4.5f;
}
public class StaticDatamembers
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Employee e = new Employee();
        System.out.println(e.experience);
        System.out.println(Employee.experience);
    }
}
mcqs.explanation:
Unlike the Instance variable, we can access static variables through objects or directly using class names. As the variable “experience” in the program is static, we don’t get an error.
Output:

$ javac StaticDatamembers.java
$ java StaticDatamembers
4.5
4.5

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Student
{
    protected String name = "Java";
}
class ProtectedVariables
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Student s = new Student();
        System.out.println(s.name);
    }
}

options.c: c) Instance variables cannot be protected

mcqs.explanation:
The protected access modifier is accessible within the package. However, it can also be accessible outside the package but through the inheritance only.
Output:

$ javac ProtectedVariables.java
$ java ProtectedVariables
Java

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Area
{
    int side;
    public int squareArea()
    {
        int a = this.side * this.side;
        return a;
    }
}
public class InstanceVariables
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Area a = new Area();
        System.out.println("Area: "+a.squareArea());
    }
}

options.a: a) Initialize instance variables before use

mcqs.explanation:
Instance variables in java are initialized to their default values if the code doesn’t explicitly initialize them. In the program, we didn’t initialize the variable “side”, so, by default, we get the value as 0 because the variable “side” is an integer.
Output:

$ javac InstanceVariables.java
$ java InstanceVariables
Area: 0

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following Java code? 
class Distance
{
    int time;
    static int speed = 10;
    static
    {
        int d = speed * time;
    }
}
public class StaticVariables
{
    public static void main(String[] args)

class Parameterised2
{  
    int num=8;

    {

    }  
    public static void main(String args[])
    {  
        Parameterised2 obj1=new Parameterised2(10);

$ java Parameterised2
