mcqs.question: Which operator among the following can be overloaded using both friend function and member function?
mcqs.explanation: Only the modulus operator among the given operators can be overloaded using either friend function or member function. Other operators must be overloaded using only the member functions.

mcqs.question: All the operators can be overloaded using the member function operator overloading.
mcqs.explanation: It is not the case that all the operators can be overloaded using the member operator overloading. There are some cases where the operators must be overloaded using the friend function only. The reason behind is that the left operand should be passed *this pointer, but the left operand in these cases might be object of some other class. Hence can’t be done.

mcqs.question: Which operator among the following must be overloaded using the friend function?

options.d: d) It’s not mandatory to use friend function in any case

mcqs.explanation: In some cases it is mandatory to use the friend functions for overloading the operators. Here both the << and >> operators must be overloaded using friend function because the left operand is object of some other class and the right operand is usually of some different type.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Overloading Member Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Overloading Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: What does memory allocation for objects mean?

options.a: a) Actual creation and memory allocation for object members
options.c: c) Creation of data members for a class
options.d: d) Actual creation and data declaration for object members

mcqs.answer: a) Actual creation and memory allocation for object members
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocated for the object members indicates actual creation of the object members. This is known as memory allocation for object.

mcqs.question: Where is the memory allocated for the objects?
mcqs.explanation: The memory for the objects or any other data is allocated in RAM initially. This is while we run a program all the memory allocation takes place in some RAM segments. Arrays in heap and local members in stack etc.

mcqs.question: When is the memory allocated for an object?

options.c: c) When object constructor is called
options.d: d) When object is initialized to another object

mcqs.answer: c) When object constructor is called
mcqs.explanation: The object memory allocation takes place when the object constructor is called. Declaration of an object doesn’t mean that memory is allocated for its members. If object is initialized with another object, it may just get a reference to the previously created object.

mcqs.question: Using new is type safe as _______________________

options.a: a) It require to be specified with type of data
options.b: b) It doesn’t require to be specified with type of data
options.c: c) It requires the name of data
options.d: d) It allocated memory for the data

mcqs.answer: b) It doesn’t require to be specified with type of data
mcqs.explanation: The new is type safe because we don’t have to specify the type of data that have to be allocated with memory. We can directly use it with data name. Name of the data doesn’t matter though for type of memory allocation though.

mcqs.question: Which of the following function can be used for dynamic memory allocation of objects?
mcqs.explanation: The malloc() function can be used to allocate dynamic memory for objects. Function calloc() can also be use. These functions differ in the way they allocate memory for objects.

mcqs.question:
How much memory will be allocated for an object of class given below? 
class Test{
int mark1;
int mark2;
float avg;
char name[10];
};
mcqs.explanation: The size of an object of the class given in question will be of size 22 bytes. This is because the size of an object is always equal to the sum of sizes of the data members of the class, except static members.

mcqs.question: Which keyword among the following can be used to declare an array of objects in java?
mcqs.explanation: The keyword new can be used to declare an array of objects in java. The syntax must be specified with an object pointer which is assigned with a memory space containing the required number of object space. Even initialization can be done directly.

mcqs.question: When is the memory allocated for an object gets free?

options.b: b) When object goes out of scope

mcqs.answer: b) When object goes out of scope
mcqs.explanation: Whenever an object goes out of scope, the deletion of allocation memory takes place. Actually the data is not deleted, instead the memory space is flagged to be free for further use. Hence whenever an object goes out of scope the object members become useless and hence memory is set free.

mcqs.question: Which among the following keyword can be used to free the allocated memory for an object?
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocated for an object is usually automatically made free. But if explicitly memory has to be made free then we can use either free or delete keywords depending on programming languages.

mcqs.question: Which function is called whenever an object goes out of scope?
mcqs.explanation: The destructor function of the class is called whenever an object goes out of scope. This is because the destructor set all the resources, acquired by the object, free. This is an implicit work of compiler.

mcqs.question: Which operator can be used to check the size of an object?
mcqs.explanation: The sizeof operator is used to get the size of an already created object. This operator must constail keyword sizeof(objectName). The output will give the number of bytes acquired by a single object of some class.

mcqs.question: The memory allocated for an object ____________________

options.c: c) Can be static or dynamic
options.d: d) Can’t be done using dynamic functions

mcqs.answer: c) Can be static or dynamic
mcqs.explanation: The memory allocation for an object can be static or dynamic. The static memory allocation is when an object is declared directly without using any function usually. And dynamic allocation is when we use some dynamic allocation function to allocate memory for data member of an object.

mcqs.question: If an object is declared in a user defined function __________________

options.a: a) Its memory is allocated in stack
options.b: b) Its memory is allocated in heap
options.c: c) Its memory is allocated in HDD
options.d: d) Its memory is allocated in cache

mcqs.answer: a) Its memory is allocated in stack
mcqs.explanation: The memory for any data or object that are used in a user defined function are always allocated in the stack. This is to ensure that the object is destroyed as soon as the function is returned. Also this ensures that the correct memory allocation and destruction is performed.

mcqs.question: In java ______________ takes care of managing memory for objects dynamically.
mcqs.explanation: The garbage collector in java takes care of the memory allocations and their deletions dynamically. When an object is no more required then the garbage collector deletes the object and free up all the resources that were held by that object.

mcqs.question: Which operator can be used to free the memory allocated for an object in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator in C++ can be used to free the memory and resources held by an object. The function can be called explicitly whenever required. In C++ memory management must be done by the programmer. There is no automatic memory management in C++.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Overriding Member Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Overriding Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following best describes member function overriding?

options.a: a) Member functions having same name in base and derived classes
options.b: b) Member functions having same name in base class only
options.c: c) Member functions having same name in derived class only
options.d: d) Member functions having same name and different signature inside main function

mcqs.answer: a) Member functions having same name in base and derived classes
mcqs.explanation: The member function which is defined in base class and again in the derived class, is overridden by the definition given in the derived class. This is because the preference is given more to the local members. When derived class object calls that function, definition from the derived class is used.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Inheritance must not be using when overriding is used
options.b: b) Overriding can be implemented without using inheritance
options.c: c) Inheritance must be done, to use overriding are overridden
options.d: d) Inheritance is mandatory only if more than one functions

mcqs.answer: c) Inheritance must be done, to use overriding are overridden
mcqs.explanation: The inheritance must be used in order to use function overriding. If inheritance is not used, the functions can only be overloaded. There must be a base class and a derived class to override the function of base class.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct condition for function overriding?

options.a: a) The declaration must not be same in base and derived class
options.b: b) The declaration must be exactly the same in base and derived class
options.c: c) The declaration should have at least 1 same argument in declaration of base and derived class
options.d: d) The declaration should have at least 1 different argument in declaration of base and derived class

mcqs.answer: b) The declaration must be exactly the same in base and derived class
mcqs.explanation: For a function to be over ridden, the declaration must be exactly the same. There must not be any different syntax used. This will ensure that the function to be overridden is only the one intended from to be overridden from the derived class.

mcqs.question: Exactly same declaration in base and derived class includes______________

options.b: b) Only same return type and name
options.c: c) Only same return type and argument list
options.d: d) All the same return type, name and parameter list

mcqs.answer: d) All the same return type, name and parameter list
mcqs.explanation: Declaration includes the whole prototype of the function. The return type name and the parameter list must be same in order to confirm that the function is same in derived and the base class. And hence can be overridden.

mcqs.question:
Which among function will be overridden from the function defined in derived class below: 
class A
{
	int i;
	void show()
	{ 
		cout<<i; 
	}
	void print()
	{ 
		cout <<i; 
	}
};
class B
{
	int j;
	void show()
	{ 
		cout<<j; 
	}
};
mcqs.explanation: The declaration must be exactly same in the derived class and base class. The derived class have defined show() function with exactly same declaration. This then shows that the function in base class is being overridden if show() is called from the object of class B.

mcqs.question: How to access the overridden method of base class from the derived class?

options.d: d) Can’t be accessed once overridden

mcqs.explanation: Scope resolution operator :: can be used to access the base class method even if overridden. To access those, first base class name should be written followed by the scope resolution operator and then the method name.

mcqs.question: The functions to be overridden _____________

options.a: a) Must be private in base class
options.b: b) Must not be private base class
options.c: c) Must be private in both derived and base class
options.d: d) Must not be private in both derived and base class

mcqs.answer: b) Must not be private base class
mcqs.explanation: If the function is private in the base class, derived class won’t be able to access it. When the derived class can’t access the function to be overridden then it won’t be able to override it with any definition.

mcqs.question: Which language doesn’t support the method overriding implicitly?
mcqs.explanation: The feature of method overriding is not provided in C#. To override the methods, one must use override or virtual keywords explicitly. This is done to remove accidental changes in program and unintentional overriding.

mcqs.question: In C# ____________________

options.a: a) Non – virtual or static methods can’t be overridden
options.b: b) Non – virtual and static methods only can be overridden
options.d: d) Overriding must be implemented using C++ code only

mcqs.answer: a) Non – virtual or static methods can’t be overridden
mcqs.explanation: The non-virtual and static methods can’t be overridden in C# language. The restriction is made from the language implicitly. Only the methods that are abstract, virtual or override can be overridden.

mcqs.question: In Delphi ______________

options.a: a) Method overriding is done implicitly
options.b: b) Method overriding is not supported
options.c: c) Method overriding is done with directive override
options.d: d) Method overriding is done with the directive virtually

mcqs.answer: c) Method overriding is done with directive override
mcqs.explanation: This is possible but only if the method to be overridden is marked as dynamic or virtual. It is inbuilt restriction of programming language. This is done to reduce the accidental or unintentional overriding.

mcqs.question: What should be used to call the base class method from the derived class if function overriding is used in Java?
mcqs.explanation: The keyword super must be used to access base class members. Even when overriding is used, super must be used with the dot operator. The overriding is possible.

mcqs.question: In Kotlin, the function to be overridden must be ______________
mcqs.explanation: The function to be overridden must be open. This is a condition in Kotlin for any function to be overridden. This avoids accidental overriding.

mcqs.question: Abstract functions of a base class _________________

options.a: a) Are overridden by the definition in same class
options.b: b) Are overridden by the definition in parent class
options.d: d) Are overridden by the definition in derived class

mcqs.answer: d) Are overridden by the definition in derived class
mcqs.explanation: The functions declared to be abstract in base class are redefined in derived classes. That is, the functions are overridden by the definitions given in the derived classes. This must be done to give at least one definition to each undefined function.

mcqs.question: If virtual functions are defined in the base class then _______________

options.a: a) It is not necessary for derived classes to override those functions
options.b: b) It is necessary for derived classes to override those functions
options.c: c) Those functions can never be derived
options.d: d) Those functions must be overridden by all the derived classes

mcqs.answer: a) It is not necessary for derived classes to override those functions
mcqs.explanation: The derived classes doesn’t have to redefine and override the base class functions. If one definition is already given it is not mandatory for any derived class to override those functions. The base class definition will be used.

mcqs.question: Which feature of OOP is exhibited by the function overriding?
mcqs.explanation: The polymorphism feature is exhibited by function overriding. Polymorphism is the feature which basically defines that same named functions can have more than one functionalities.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Constant Member Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Constant Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: What are the constant member functions?

options.a: a) Functions which doesn’t change value of calling object
options.b: b) Functions which doesn’t change value of any object inside definition
options.c: c) Functions which doesn’t allow modification of any object of class
options.d: d) Functions which doesn’t allow modification of argument objects

mcqs.answer: a) Functions which doesn’t change value of calling object
mcqs.explanation: The constant member functions are a special type of member functions. These are intended to restrict any modification in to the values of object which is used to invoke that function. This is done to ensure that there are no accidental modifications to the object.

mcqs.question: Which keyword must be used to declare a member function as a constant member function?
mcqs.explanation: The keyword const is provided in most of the programming languages. This indicates that the member on which it is specified remains constant with the respective values of members. The keyword must be mentioned so as to declare a member function to be constant.

mcqs.question: Which objects can call the const functions?

options.c: c) Both const and non-const objects
options.d: d) Neither const not non-const objects

mcqs.answer: c) Both const and non-const objects
mcqs.explanation: All the objects of a class can call const functions for its use. Const objects can call the const functions to since those values are already constant. And the non- const objects can call the const functions to keep their values constant.

mcqs.question: Non-const functions _______________________

options.a: a) Can be called only from non-const object
options.b: b) Can be called only from const object
options.c: c) Can be called both by const and non-const object
options.d: d) Can’t be called with object

mcqs.answer: a) Can be called only from non-const object
mcqs.explanation: The non-const functions are able to modify the values of object which called the function. So only the non-const functions can be called. If const object is used then the compiler produces an error as the const object is being given to a function which can modify its values.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct condition on const member functions?

options.a: a) Const member functions can’t call non-const member functions
options.b: b) Const member functions can’t call any other function
options.c: c) Const member functions can call only the functions which are neither const nor non-const
options.d: d) Const member functions can call only data members of call not member functions

mcqs.answer: a) Const member functions can’t call non-const member functions
mcqs.explanation: The const member functions are restricted to call any other non-const member functions. This is to ensure that the const function doesn’t have any code that might modify the calling object.

mcqs.question: If a const object calls a non-const member function then ____________________

options.a: a) Run time error may get produced
options.b: b) Compile time error may get produced
options.c: c) Either compile time or run time error is produced
options.d: d) The program can’t be compiled

mcqs.answer: b) Compile time error may get produced
mcqs.explanation: The program gets compiled but produces an error. The error is produced because a constant value is being changed. Even if there is no code that can change any object value, but non-const member functions are assumed to change the values.

mcqs.question: Can a constructor function be constant?

options.b: b) Yes, only if permissions are given
options.c: c) No, because objects are not involved

mcqs.explanation: The constructors can’t be made const. This is to ensure that the constructor is capable of initializing the values to the members of the object. If it is made constant then it won’t be able to initialize any data member values.

mcqs.question: A function can have both the const and non-const version in the same program.
mcqs.explanation: The functions in a program can be made both const and non-const. This feature is made available to make programming more flexible. This ensures the security too as we can call const function whenever required.

mcqs.question: How is it possible to have both const and non-const version of a function?
mcqs.explanation: The functions can be declared const and non-const in the same program. The technique used is function overloading. We can define a const function and then a non-const version of same function using overloading.

mcqs.question: When both the const and non-const version of functions are required?

options.a: a) Return value have to be different in const
options.b: b) Return value have to be same in const
options.c: c) Return values have to be ignored
options.d: d) Return values have to be suppressed

mcqs.answer: a) Return value have to be different in const
mcqs.explanation: The return values can help to overload the functions. Also, this will allow us to use a non-const function to be called inside both the const and non-const version of functions.

mcqs.question: If a function is to be made const, which is the correct syntax?
mcqs.explanation: The function declaration must contain the keyword const. The const keyword makes the function const type. The usual function declaration can be given followed by the keyword. The keyword const can be given after the declaration of function and before definition.

mcqs.question: Functions which differ in const-ness are considered ______________________

options.c: c) To produce compile time error

mcqs.explanation: The functions are considered to have different signature. This is because the const-ness also defines the type of function or the working of functions. And hence the functions can be considered different. This is the reason that we can use function overloading for const and non-const version of same function.

mcqs.question: If const version of a function when overloading is used, the function ___________________
mcqs.explanation: The function returns a const reference. This is to ensure that the value of object calling the function is not modified. This is a security feature.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is recommended for const functions?

options.a: a) Const function use should be reduced in a program
options.b: b) Const function use should be more in a program
options.c: c) Const function use should not matter in a program
options.d: d) Const function use should be able to modify the values

mcqs.answer: b) Const function use should be more in a program
mcqs.explanation: The const member functions should be used more in a program. The reason behind is to ensure there is no accidental modification of data of object. Also to ensure any unintended modification which may result in unexpected termination of program.

mcqs.question: Use of const member function in a program _________________________

options.c: c) Is mandatory, if objects are used
options.d: d) Is optional, if const objects are used

mcqs.explanation: The use of const member functions is not mandatory. If const objects are involved then there is a high use of const member functions too. But there is no mandatory condition.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Private Member Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers focuses on “Private Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: Which is private member functions access scope?

options.a: a) Member functions which can only be used within the class
options.b: b) Member functions which can used outside the class
options.c: c) Member functions which are accessible in derived class
options.d: d) Member functions which can’t be accessed inside the class

mcqs.answer: a) Member functions which can only be used within the class
mcqs.explanation: The member functions can be accessed inside the class only if they are private. The access is scope is limited to ensure the security of the private members and their usage.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) The private members can’t be accessed by public members of the class
options.b: b) The private members can be accessed by public members of the class
options.c: c) The private members can be accessed only by the private members of the class
options.d: d) The private members can’t be accessed by the protected members of the class

mcqs.answer: b) The private members can be accessed by public members of the class
mcqs.explanation: The private members are accessible within the class. There is no restriction on use of private members by public or protected members. All the members can access the private member functions of the class.

mcqs.question: Which member can never be accessed by inherited classes?
mcqs.explanation: The private member functions can never be accessed in the derived classes. The access specifiers is of maximum security that allows only the members of self class to access the private member functions.

mcqs.question: Which syntax among the following shows that a member is private in a class?
mcqs.explanation: The function declaration must contain private keyword follower by the return type and function name. Private keyword is followed by normal function declaration.

mcqs.question: If private member functions are to be declared in C++ then _____________
mcqs.explanation: The private members doesn’t have to have the keyword with each private member. We only have to specify the keyword private followed by single colon and then private member’s are listed.

mcqs.question: In java, which rule must be followed?

options.a: a) Keyword private preceding list of private member’s
options.b: b) Keyword private with a colon before list of private member’s
options.c: c) Keyword private with arrow before each private member
options.d: d) Keyword private preceding each private member

mcqs.answer: d) Keyword private preceding each private member
mcqs.explanation: The private keyword must be mentioned before each private member. Unlike the rule in C++ to specify private once and list all other private member’s, in java all member declarations must be preceded by the keyword private.

mcqs.question: How many private member functions are allowed in a class?
mcqs.explanation: There are no conditions applied on the number of private member functions that can be declared in a class. Though the system may restrict use of too many functions depending on memory.

mcqs.question: How to access a private member function of a class?

options.c: c) Using address of member function

mcqs.answer: c) Using address of member function
mcqs.explanation: Even the private member functions can be called outside the class. This is possible if address of the function is known. We can use the address to call the function outside the class.

mcqs.question: Private member functions ____________

options.a: a) Can’t be called from enclosing class
options.b: b) Can be accessed from enclosing class
options.c: c) Can be accessed only if nested class is private
options.d: d) Can be accessed only if nested class is public

mcqs.answer: a) Can’t be called from enclosing class
mcqs.explanation: The nested class members can’t be accessed in the enclosed class even though other members can be accessed. This is to ensure the class members security and not to go against the rules of private members.

mcqs.question: Which function among the following can’t be accessed outside the class in java in same package?
mcqs.explanation: The protected members are available within the class. And are also available in derived classes. But these members are treated as private members for outside the class and inheritance structure. Hence can’t be accessed.

mcqs.question: If private members are to be called outside the class, which is a good alternative?

options.a: a) Call a public member function which calls private function
options.b: b) Call a private member function which calls private function
options.c: c) Call a protected member function which calls private function

mcqs.answer: a) Call a public member function which calls private function
mcqs.explanation: The private member functions can be accessed within the class. A public member function can be called which in turn calls the private member function. This maintains the security and adheres to the rules of private members.

mcqs.question: A private function of a derived class can be accessed by the parent class.
mcqs.explanation: If private functions get accessed even by the parent class that will violate the rules of private members. If the functions can be accessed then the derived class security is hindered.

mcqs.question: Which error will be produced if private members are accessed?
mcqs.explanation: The private members access from outside the class produce an error. The error states that the code at some line can’t access the private members. And denies the access terminating the program.

mcqs.question: Can main() function be made private?

options.b: b) Yes, if program doesn’t contain any classes
options.c: c) No, because main function is user defined

mcqs.explanation: The reason given in option “No, because main function is user defined” is wrong. The proper reason that the main function should not be private is that it should be accessible in whole program. This makes the program flexible.

mcqs.question: If a function in java is declared private then it __________________

options.a: a) Can’t access the standard output
options.b: b) Can access the standard output
options.c: c) Can’t access any output stream
options.d: d) Can access only the output streams

mcqs.answer: b) Can access the standard output
mcqs.explanation: The private members can access any standard input or output. There is no restriction on access to any input or output stream. And since standard input can also be used hence only accessing the output stream is not true.

links.text: Object Oriented Programming MCQ: Public Member Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Public Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: What are public member functions?

options.a: a) Functions accessible outside the class but not in derived class
options.b: b) Functions accessible outside the class directly
options.c: c) Functions accessible everywhere using object of class
options.d: d) Functions that can’t be accessed outside the class

mcqs.answer: c) Functions accessible everywhere using object of class
mcqs.explanation: The most suitable definition would be that public member functions are accessible everywhere using object of the class. If derived classes are using those, derived class object can be used to call those functions.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for public member functions?

options.a: a) Public member functions doesn’t have a return type
options.b: b) Public member functions doesn’t have any security
options.c: c) Public member functions are declared outside the class
options.d: d) Public member functions can be called using object of class

mcqs.answer: d) Public member functions can be called using object of class
mcqs.explanation: The public member functions can be called using object of the class. The members can’t be declared outside the class as those would become non-member functions of the class. The functions have security as those can be accessed using the class object only.

mcqs.question: Which type of member functions get inherited in the same specifier in which the inheritance is done? (If private inheritance is used, those become private and if public used, those become public)
mcqs.explanation: The public member functions gets into the same specifier in which the inheritance is done. If protected members are involved in public inheritance, still those remain protected in the derived class but public members become public on public inheritance and protected in protected inheritance.

mcqs.question: Which syntax among the following is correct for public member functions?
mcqs.explanation: The public member functions declaration must be mentioned with the keyword public. The syntax given is used in java. Keyword public is followed by the usual function declaration.

mcqs.question: Which syntax is applicable to declare public member functions in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax in C++ must contain the public keyword followed by a colon. Thereafter, all the public members can be declared. But in few other language, public have to be mentioned explicitly with each member.

mcqs.question: In java, which rule among the following is applicable?

options.a: a) Keyword public can’t be preceded with all the public members
options.b: b) Keyword public must be preceded with all the public members
options.c: c) Keyword public must be post mentioned the function declaration
options.d: d) Keyword public is not mandatory

mcqs.answer: b) Keyword public must be preceded with all the public members
mcqs.explanation: The public members in java must be preceded with the keyword public. It must be mentioned with each public member, unlike C++ where we mention it only once. In java, each member must have explicit declaration of specifier type.

mcqs.question: How many public members are allowed in a class?
mcqs.explanation: The number of public members that can be defined in a class doesn’t have any limit. Though the programmer should not use too many functions, instead should use another class for more specific functions to reduce the readability complexity.

mcqs.question: Which is not a proper way to access public members of a class?

options.a: a) Using object pointer with arrow operator
options.b: b) Using object of class in main function
options.c: c) Using object of class with arrow operator
options.d: d) Using object anywhere in the program

mcqs.answer: c) Using object of class with arrow operator
mcqs.explanation: The public members can be accessed anywhere in the program using the object of the class. And if object pointer is used, then arrow operator is used to access class members. If normal object is used with arrow operator, an error will be generated.

mcqs.question: Which call is correct for public members of a nested class?

options.a: a) Can be called from object of enclosing class
options.b: b) Can be called within enclosing class only with direct names
options.c: c) Direct names should be used for the nested classes
options.d: d) Only with help of nested class object pointer

mcqs.answer: a) Can be called from object of enclosing class
mcqs.explanation: The closest definition is that any public member function of the nested class can be accessed with the help of enclosing class object. The nested class object pointer can be used only within the enclosing class. It’s not mandatory to use the members of nested class only within the enclosing class.

mcqs.question: Which public function call among the following is correct outside the class, if return type is void (C++)?
mcqs.explanation: The condition given says that there is no return type hence we can call the function directly. The object name should be mentioned with a dot operator to access its class members. Then the function name with parameters, if required, can be given.

mcqs.question: If public members are to be restricted from getting inherited from the subclass of the class containing that function, which alternative is best?
mcqs.explanation: If private inheritance is used then the class containing the function will be able to use the function with rules of whichever specifier is used. Then the derived class makes those function the private members of itself. This restricts the public members of parent class from further inheritance.

mcqs.question: A derived class object can access the public members of the base class.
mcqs.explanation: The public members of the base class can be accessed from the derived class object only if public inheritance is used. If protected or private inheritance is used then those members become public/protected in derived class and hence won’t be able to be called from object of the derived class.

mcqs.question: If a class have a public member function and is called directly in the main function then ___________________________

options.a: a) Undeclared function error will be produced
options.b: b) Out of memory error is given
options.d: d) Program shut down the computer

mcqs.answer: a) Undeclared function error will be produced
mcqs.explanation: If the function is called directly without using any object then the compiler doesn’t gets to know that the function have to be called from a specific class. And if there are no global or in-scope function with same name then the compiler produces an error stating that the called function is undeclared.

mcqs.question: The function main() must always be public.
mcqs.explanation: The main() function must always be public. This is because the whole function and the operating system that is out of the package have to access the main function throughout the program execution. Hence the main() function should be public so as to be available everywhere in the program.

mcqs.question: All the public member functions ___________________

options.a: a) Can’t access the private members of a class
options.b: b) Can’t access the protected members of a class
options.c: c) Can access only public members of a class
options.d: d) Can access all the member of its class

mcqs.answer: d) Can access all the member of its class
mcqs.explanation: The public member function can access any private, protected and public member of its class. Not only public member function, any member function of a class can access each and every other member declared inside the class. Hence are flexible to program.

title: 13. OOPs MCQ on Exception Handling & Static Class Members

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Exception Handling”.

mcqs.question: What is an exception?

options.a: a) Problem arising during compile time

mcqs.explanation: The problems that might occur during execution of a program are known as exceptions. The exceptions are unexpected sometimes and can be predicted. Also, the exceptions should be always considered for a better program.

mcqs.question: Why do we need to handle exceptions?

options.a: a) To prevent abnormal termination of program
options.b: b) To encourage exception prone program

mcqs.answer: a) To prevent abnormal termination of program
mcqs.explanation: The exceptions should be handled to prevent any abnormal termination of a program. The program should keep running even if it gets interrupted in between. The program should preferable show the error occurred and then retry the process or just continue the program further.

mcqs.question: An exception may arise when _______________

options.b: b) Input is some constant value of program

mcqs.explanation: The exceptions may arise because the input given by the user might not be of the same type that a program can manage. If the input is invalid the program gets terminated.

mcqs.question: If a file that needs to be opened is not found in the target location then _____________

options.c: c) Exception might get produced because of syntax
options.d: d) Exceptions are not produced because of logic

mcqs.explanation: The exceptions are produced when anything unexpected happened. The program might not be able to find a file in the target location and hence program produces an exceptions. The exception produced, then terminates the program.

mcqs.question: Which is the universal exception handler class?
mcqs.explanation: Any type of exception can be handled by using class Exceptions. An object of this class is created which can manipulate the exception data. The data can be used to display the error or to run the program further based on error produced.

mcqs.question: What are two exception classes in hierarchy of java exceptions class?

options.c: c) Runtime exceptions and other exceptions

mcqs.answer: c) Runtime exceptions and other exceptions
mcqs.explanation: The exceptions class is having two other derived classes which are of runtime exception handler and for other type of exceptions handling. The runtime exception handler is used to handle the exceptions produced during run time and same with case of other exceptions.

mcqs.question: Which are the two blocks that are used to check error and handle the error?
mcqs.explanation: Two blocks that are used to check for errors and to handle the errors are try and catch block. The code which might produce some exceptions is placed inside the try block and then the catch block is written to catch the error that is produced. The error message or any other processing can be done in catch block if the error is produced.

mcqs.question: There can be a try block without catch block but vice versa is not possible.
mcqs.explanation: The try block may or may not have any catch block. But a catch block can’t be there in a program if there is no try block. It is like else-block can only be written if and only if if-block is present in the program.

mcqs.question: How many catch blocks can a single try block can have?
mcqs.explanation: There is no limit on the number of catch blocks corresponding to a try block. This is because the error can be of any type and for each type, a new catch block can be defined. This is to make sure all type of exceptions can be handled.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is not a method of Throwable class?
mcqs.explanation: Actually all the functions are available in throwable class. But the return type given in the option is wrong. The function toString returns string value. Hence the return type must be a String and not a char.

mcqs.question: To catch the exceptions ___________________

options.a: a) An object must be created to catch the exception
options.b: b) A variable should be created to catch the exception
options.c: c) An array should be created to catch all the exceptions
options.d: d) A string have to be created to store the exception

mcqs.answer: a) An object must be created to catch the exception
mcqs.explanation: The object must be created of a specific class of which the error has occurred. If the type of error is unknown then we can use an object of class Exceptions. This object will be able to handle any kind of exception that a program might produce.

mcqs.question: Multiple catch blocks __________________

options.a: a) Are mandatory for each try block
options.b: b) Can be combined into a single catch block
options.c: c) Are not possible for a try block
options.d: d) Can never be associated with a single try block

mcqs.answer: b) Can be combined into a single catch block
mcqs.explanation: The separate catch blocks for a single try block can be combined into a single catch block. All type of errors can be then handled in s single block. The type still have to be specified for the errors that might be produced.

mcqs.question: Which symbol should be used to separate the type of exception handler classes in a single catch block?
mcqs.explanation: A pipe symbol can be used to separate different type of exceptions. The exceptions should always be given in proper sequence to ensure that no code remains unreachable. If not done properly the code might never be used in a program.

mcqs.question: Which class is used to handle the input and output exceptions?
mcqs.explanation: There is a specific class to handle each type of exceptions that might be produced in a program. The input and output exceptions can be handled by an object of class IOExcceptions. This class handles all type of input and output exceptions.

mcqs.question: Why do we use finally block?

options.a: a) To execute the block if exception occurred
options.b: b) To execute a code when exception is not occurred
options.c: c) To execute a code whenever required
options.d: d) To execute a code with each and every run of program

mcqs.answer: d) To execute a code with each and every run of program
mcqs.explanation: Sometimes there is a need to execute a set of code every time the program runs. Even if the exception occurs and even if it doesn’t, there can be some code that must be executed at end of the program. That code is written in finally block. This block is always executed regardless of exceptions occurring.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Catching Class Types”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for class exceptions?

options.a: a) Only base class can give rise to exceptions
options.b: b) Only derived class can give rise to exceptions
options.c: c) Either base class or derived class may produce exceptions
options.d: d) Both base class and derived class may produce exceptions

mcqs.answer: d) Both base class and derived class may produce exceptions
mcqs.explanation: It’s not mandatory that either base class or derived class can give rise to exceptions. The exceptions might get produced from any class. The exceptions depends on code.

mcqs.question: If both base and derived class caught exceptions ______________

options.a: a) Then catch block of derived class must be defined before base class
options.b: b) Then catch block of base class must be defined before the derived class
options.c: c) Then catch block of base and derived classes doesn’t matter
options.d: d) Then catch block of base and derived classes are not mandatory to be defined

mcqs.answer: a) Then catch block of derived class must be defined before base class
mcqs.explanation: It is a condition for writing the catch blocks for base and derived classes. It is mandatory to write derived class catch block first because the errors produced by the derived class must be handled first.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) If catch block of base class is written first, it is compile time error
options.b: b) If catch block of base class is written first, it is run time error
options.c: c) If catch block of base class is written first, derived class catch block can’t be reached
options.d: d) If catch block of base class is written first, only derived class catch block is executed

mcqs.answer: c) If catch block of base class is written first, derived class catch block can’t be reached
mcqs.explanation: If the catch block of the base class is defined first and then the derived class catch block is given. The code becomes unreachable. Hence the derived class catch block must be written first.

mcqs.question: The catching of base class exception ___________________________ in java.

options.a: a) After derived class is not allowed by compiler
options.b: b) Before derived class is not allowed by compiler
options.c: c) Before derived class is allowed
options.d: d) After derived class can’t be done

mcqs.answer: b) Before derived class is not allowed by compiler
mcqs.explanation: The catching of base class exception before derived class is not allowed in java. The compiler itself doesn’t allow this declaration. It produces an error.

mcqs.question: If catching of base class exception is done before derived class in C++ ________________

options.a: a) It gives compile time error
options.b: b) It doesn’t run the program
options.c: c) It may give warning but not error
options.d: d) It always gives compile time error

mcqs.answer: c) It may give warning but not error
mcqs.explanation: The compiler in C++ doesn’t identify this as compile time error and allows the execution of the program. But, the compiler may give some warning related to the catch block sequence or code unreachable.

mcqs.question: How many catch blocks can a class have?
mcqs.explanation: There are many type of exceptions that may arise while running a code. And each catch block can handle only one exception. Hence there can be as many catch blocks as required.

mcqs.question: Since which version of java is multiple exception catch was made possible?
mcqs.explanation: None of the languages used to support multiple exception catch in a single catch block. Since java 7 the feature was added to catch more than one exceptions in one catch block.

mcqs.question: To catch more than one exception in one catch block, how are the exceptions separated in the syntax?
mcqs.explanation: Just the way we separate the arguments in a function definition using comma. Here we separate the exceptions by using a vertical bar or we call it pipe symbol sometimes. This is just a convention followed to separate different exception list.

mcqs.question: If a catch block accepts more than one exceptions then __________________

options.a: a) The catch parameters are not final
options.b: b) The catch parameters are final
options.c: c) The catch parameters are not defined
options.d: d) The catch parameters are not used

mcqs.answer: b) The catch parameters are final
mcqs.explanation: The catch parameters are made final. This is to ensure that the parameters are not changed inside the catch block. Hence those retain their values.

mcqs.question: Which among the following handles the undefined class in program?
mcqs.explanation: It is the exception handler that handles the exceptions when the class used is not found in the program. This is done to handle all the undefined class exceptions. This can be due to a command line error.

mcqs.question: If classes produce some exceptions, then ______________________

options.a: a) Their respective catch block must be defined
options.b: b) Their respective catch blocks are not mandatory
options.c: c) Their catch blocks should be defined inside main function
options.d: d) Their catch blocks must be defined at the end of program

mcqs.answer: a) Their respective catch block must be defined
mcqs.explanation: The catch blocks must be defined. This is to ensure that all the exceptions related to the classes are handled by the program code and the program doesn’t terminate unexpectedly.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Only the base class catch blocks are important
options.b: b) Only the derived class catch blocks are important
options.c: c) Both the base and derived class catch blocks are important
options.d: d) If base and derived classes both produce exceptions, program doesn’t run

mcqs.answer: c) Both the base and derived class catch blocks are important
mcqs.explanation: The purpose of exception handling is to handle the unexpected errors in the program. If base class might produce some error then its catch block must be given and if the derived class might produce some error then it must be given a specific catch block too.

mcqs.question: Which is the necessary condition to define the base and derived class catch blocks?

options.a: a) Base class catch should be defined first
options.b: b) Derived class catch should be defined first
options.c: c) Catch block for both the classes must not be defined
options.d: d) Catch block must be defined inside main function

mcqs.answer: b) Derived class catch should be defined first
mcqs.explanation: The derived class catch blocks must be defined prior to the base class catch block. This is to ensure that all the catch boxes are reachable. If not done, the code might become unreachable which in turn makes the program prone to errors.

mcqs.question: Only the base class catch box can handle more than one exception in single block.
mcqs.explanation: There is no specific condition that states that only base class catch box can handle more than one exception in single box. Even the derived class catch clocks can handle more than one exceptions.

mcqs.question: Which condition among the following might result in memory exception?

options.b: b) Nested if conditions that are all false
options.d: d) Loop that runs exactly 99 times

mcqs.explanation: The infinite loops doesn’t stop running once started. There must be a way to stop the loop but that is always an improper termination. Infinite loops may keep on using more memory and hence would result in memory error.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Static Data Members”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following best defines static variables members?

options.a: a) Data which is allocated for each object separately
options.b: b) Data which is common to all the objects of a class
options.c: c) Data which is common to all the classes
options.d: d) Data which is common to a specific method

mcqs.answer: b) Data which is common to all the objects of a class
mcqs.explanation: The static data members are made common to all the object of a class. They doesn’t change from object to object. Those are property of class rather than of any individual object.

mcqs.question: Which keyword should be used to declare static variables?
mcqs.explanation: The keyword used to declare static variables is static. This is must be used while declaring the static variables. The compiler can make variables static if and only if they are mentioned with static keyword.

mcqs.question: Any changes made to static data member from one member function _____________

options.a: a) Is reflected to only the corresponding object
options.b: b) Is reflected to all the variables in a program
options.c: c) Is reflected to all the objects of that class
options.d: d) Is constant to that function only

mcqs.answer: c) Is reflected to all the objects of that class
mcqs.explanation: The changes made from any function to static data member will be a common change for all the other objects also. If the change is made with respect to one object and change is printed from another object, the result will be same.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for declaring static data member?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax must firstly be mentioned with the keyword static. Then the data type of the member followed by the member name should be given. This is general form of declaring static data members.

mcqs.question: The static data member ______________________

options.a: a) Must be defined inside the class
options.b: b) Must be defined outside the class
options.c: c) Must be defined in main function
options.d: d) Must be defined using constructor

mcqs.answer: b) Must be defined outside the class
mcqs.explanation: The static data members must be defined outside the class. Since these are common to all the objects and should be created only once, they must not be defined in the constructor.

mcqs.question: The syntax for defining the static data members is __________
mcqs.explanation: The syntax doesn’t contain the static keyword. Since it is already been declared as static inside the class. The data type and the corresponding class name must be there to allocate the variable to a class. The value is assigned using scope resolution operator for the member name.

mcqs.question: If static data members have to be used inside a class, those member functions _______________

options.a: a) Must not be static member functions
options.b: b) Must not be member functions
options.c: c) Must be static member functions
options.d: d) Must not be member function of corresponding class

mcqs.answer: c) Must be static member functions
mcqs.explanation: Only the static member functions can access the static data members. The definition of static members is made common and hence the member function should be capable of manipulating the static data members.

mcqs.question: The static data member __________________________

options.b: b) Can be accessed with any public class name
options.c: c) Can be accessed with dot operator
options.d: d) Can be accessed using class name if not using static member function

mcqs.answer: d) Can be accessed using class name if not using static member function
mcqs.explanation: The static data members can be accessed using the class name also. If the member functions is not used or is not to be used then we can call the static data members directly by using its corresponding class name.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the correct syntax to access static data member without using member function?
mcqs.explanation: For accessing the static data members without using the static member functions, the class name can be used. The class name followed by scope resolution, indicating that static data members is member of this class, and then the data member name.

mcqs.question: Which data members among the following are static by default?
mcqs.explanation: The const data members of any class are made static by default. This is an implicit meaning given by the compiler to the member. Since const values won’t change from object to object, hence are made static instead.

mcqs.question:
What is the output of the following program? 
class Test
{
	private:	static int x;
	public: static void fun()
	{
		cout << ++x << “ ”;
	}
};
int Test :: x =20;
void main()
{
	Test x;
	x.fun();
	x.fun();
}
mcqs.explanation: The static member is initialized with 20. Then the function is called which used pre-increment and printed value of x. The function is called twice. Hence we get 21 22 as output.

mcqs.question: Whenever any static data member is declared in a class ______________________

options.a: a) Only one copy of the data is created
options.b: b) New copy for each object is created
options.c: c) New memory location is allocated with each object
options.d: d) Only one object uses the static data

mcqs.answer: a) Only one copy of the data is created
mcqs.explanation: The static data is same for all the objects. Instead of creating the same data each time an object is created, the compiler created only one data which is accessed by all the objects of the class. This saves memory and reduces redundancy.

mcqs.question: If object of class are created, then the static data members can be accessed ____________

options.d: d) Using dot or arrow operator

mcqs.answer: d) Using dot or arrow operator
mcqs.explanation: The static data members can be accessed in usual way as other members are accessed using the objects. The dot operator is used generally. Arrow can be used with the pointers.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the following program? 
class Test
{
	public: Test() 
	{ 
		cout  << "Test's Constructor is Called " << endl;  
	}
};
 
class Result
{
	static Test a;
	public:
	Result() 
	{ 
		cout  << "Result's Constructor is Called " << endl; 
	}
}; 
 
void main() 
{ 
	Result b; 
}

options.c: c) Result’s Constructor Called Test’s Constructor is Called
options.d: d) Test’s Constructor Called Result’s Constructor is Called

mcqs.explanation: The output is the message printed from the constructor of class Result. There is no inheritance used hence only one constructor is called. Since static members are declared once in class declaration and are not defined. The constructor of class Test will not be called.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is wrong syntax related to static data members?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax given in option d doesn’t belong to any particular declaration or definition. First one is to access the static members using the class name. Second is to define the static data outside the class. Third syntax id to declare a data member as static in a class.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Static Member Functions”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is correct definition for static member functions?

options.a: a) Functions created to allocate constant values to each object
options.b: b) Functions made to maintain single copy of member functions for all objects
options.c: c) Functions created to define the static members
options.d: d) Functions made to manipulate static programs

mcqs.answer: b) Functions made to maintain single copy of member functions for all objects
mcqs.explanation: The functions which are made common, with respect to definition and data usage, to all the objects. These functions are able to access the static data members of a class.

mcqs.question: The static member functions __________________

options.a: a) Have access to all the members of a class
options.b: b) Have access to only constant members of a class
options.c: c) Have access to only the static members of a class
options.d: d) Have direct access to all other class members also

mcqs.answer: c) Have access to only the static members of a class
mcqs.explanation: The static member functions are common for all the objects. These functions can use only the static members of a class in which those are defined. This is because other members change with respect to each object created.

mcqs.question: The static member functions ____________________

options.a: a) Can be called using class name
options.b: b) Can be called using program name
options.d: d) Can’t be called outside the function

mcqs.answer: a) Can be called using class name
mcqs.explanation: The static members can be accessed using class name also. This is because the static members remain common to all the objects. Hence objects are not required.

mcqs.question: Which is correct syntax to access the static member functions with class name?
mcqs.explanation: The scope resolution operator must be used to access the static member functions with class name. This indicates that the function belongs to the corresponding class.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is not applicable for the static member functions?
mcqs.explanation: Since the static members are not property of objects, they doesn’t have this pointer. Every time the same member is referred from all the objects, hence use of this pointer is of no use.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Static member functions can’t be virtual
options.b: b) Static member functions can be virtual
options.c: c) Static member functions can be declared virtual if it is pure virtual class
options.d: d) Static member functions can be used as virtual in Java

mcqs.answer: a) Static member functions can’t be virtual
mcqs.explanation: The static member functions can’t be virtual. This is a restriction on static member functions, since the definition should not change or should not be overridden by any other function of derived class. The static members must remain same for all the objects.

mcqs.question: The static members are ______________________

options.a: a) Created with each new object
options.b: b) Created twice in a program
options.c: c) Created as many times a class is used
options.d: d) Created and initialized only once

mcqs.answer: d) Created and initialized only once
mcqs.explanation: The static members are created only once. Then those members are reused whenever called or invoked. Memory is allocated only once.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Static member functions can be overloaded
options.b: b) Static member functions can’t be overloaded
options.c: c) Static member functions can be overloaded using derived classes
options.d: d) Static member functions are implicitly overloaded

mcqs.answer: b) Static member functions can’t be overloaded
mcqs.explanation: The static member functions can’t be overloaded because the definition must be the same for all the instances of a class. If an overloaded function have many definitions, none of them can be made static.

mcqs.question: The static member functions _______________

options.c: c) Can’t be declared const or volatile
options.d: d) Can’t be declared const, volatile or const volatile

mcqs.answer: d) Can’t be declared const, volatile or const volatile
mcqs.explanation: The static member functions can’t be made const, since any object or class itself should be capable of making changes to the function. And the function must retain all changes common to all the objects.

mcqs.question: Which keyword should be used to declare the static member functions?
mcqs.explanation: The member functions which are to be made static, must be preceded with the keyword static. This indicates the compiler to make the functions common to all the objects. And a new copy is not created with each of the new object.

mcqs.question: The keyword static is used _______________

options.a: a) With declaration inside class and with definition outside the class
options.b: b) With declaration inside class and not with definition outside the class
options.c: c) With declaration and definition wherever done
options.d: d) With each call to the member function

mcqs.answer: b) With declaration inside class and not with definition outside the class
mcqs.explanation: The keyword is used only inside the class while declaring the static member. Outside the class, only definition with proper syntax is given. There is no need of specifying the keyword static again.

mcqs.question: Which among the following can’t be used to access the members in any way?
mcqs.explanation: The single colon can’t be used in any way in order to access the static members of a class. Other symbols can be used according to the code and need.

mcqs.question: We can use the static member functions and static data member __________________

options.a: a) Even if class object is not created
options.b: b) Even if class is not defined
options.c: c) Even if class doesn’t contain any static member
options.d: d) Even if class doesn’t have complete definition

mcqs.answer: a) Even if class object is not created
mcqs.explanation: The static members are property of class as a whole. There is no need of specific objects to call static members. Those can be called directly or with class name.

mcqs.question: The static data member _________________
mcqs.explanation: The static data members can never be mutable. There copies are not made. Since those are common and created only once.

mcqs.question: If static data member are made inline, ______________

options.a: a) Those should be initialized outside the class
options.b: b) Those can’t be initialized with the class
options.c: c) Those can be initialized within the class
options.d: d) Those can’t be used by class members

mcqs.answer: c) Those can be initialized within the class
mcqs.explanation: Since the members are created once and are common for all the instances, those can be initialized inside the class. Those doesn’t change with each object being created hence can be defined inside the class once for all.

title: 14. OOPs MCQ on Assigning Object, Pointer to Objects, Passing and Returning Object

links.text: OOPs MCQ: Passing Object to Functions
links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Passing Object to Functions”.

mcqs.question: Passing object to a function _______________

options.a: a) Can be done only in one way
options.b: b) Can be done in more than one ways
options.d: d) Is not possible in OOP

mcqs.answer: b) Can be done in more than one ways
mcqs.explanation: The objects can be passed to the functions and this requires OOP concept because objects are main part of OOP. The objects can be passed in more than one way to a function. The passing depends on how the object have to be used.

mcqs.question: The object ________________

options.a: a) Can be passed by reference
options.b: b) Can be passed by value
options.c: c) Can be passed by reference or value
options.d: d) Can be passed with reference

mcqs.answer: c) Can be passed by reference or value
mcqs.explanation: The objects can be passed by reference if required to use the same object. The values can be passed so that the main object remains same and no changes are made to it if the function makes any changes to the values being passed.

mcqs.question: Which symbol should be used to pass the object by reference in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The object to be passed by reference to the function should be preceded by & symbol in the argument list syntax of the function. This indicates the compiler not to use new object. The same object which is being passed have to be used.

mcqs.question: If object is passed by value ______________

options.a: a) Copy constructor is used to copy the values into another object in the function
options.b: b) Copy constructor is used to copy the values into temporary object
options.c: c) Reference to the object is used to access the values of the object
options.d: d) Reference to the object is used to created new object in its place

mcqs.answer: a) Copy constructor is used to copy the values into another object in the function
mcqs.explanation: The copy constructor is used. This constructor is used to copy the values into a new object which will contain all the values same as that of the object being passed but any changes made to the newly created object will not affect the original object.

mcqs.question: Pass by reference of an object to a function _______________

options.a: a) Affects the object in called function only
options.b: b) Affects the object in prototype only
options.c: c) Affects the object in caller function
options.d: d) Affects the object only if mentioned with & symbol with every call

mcqs.answer: c) Affects the object in caller function
mcqs.explanation: The original object in the caller function will get affected. The changes made in the called function will be same in the caller function object also.

mcqs.question: Copy constructor definition requires __________________

options.a: a) Object to be passed by value
options.b: b) Object not to be passed to it
options.c: c) Object to be passed by reference
options.d: d) Object to be passed with each data member value

mcqs.answer: c) Object to be passed by reference
mcqs.explanation: The object must be passed by reference to a copy constructor. This is to avoid the out of memory error. The constructors keeps calling itself, if not passed by reference, and goes out of memory.

mcqs.question: What is the type of object that should be specified in the argument list?
mcqs.explanation: The type of object is the class itself. The class name have to be specified in order to pass the objects to a function. This allows the program to create another object of same class or to use the same object that was passed.

mcqs.question: If an object is passed by value, _________________

options.a: a) Temporary object is used in the function
options.b: b) Local object in the function is used
options.c: c) Only the data member values are used
options.d: d) The values are accessible from the original object

mcqs.answer: b) Local object in the function is used
mcqs.explanation: When an object is called by values, copy constructor is called and object is copied to the local object of the function which is mentioned in the argument list. The values gets copied and are used from the local object. There is no need to access the original object again.

mcqs.question: Can data members be passed to a function using the object?

options.a: a) Yes, it can be passed only inside class functions
options.b: b) Yes, only if the data members are public and are being passed to a function outside the class
options.c: c) No, can’t be passed outside the class

mcqs.answer: b) Yes, only if the data members are public and are being passed to a function outside the class
mcqs.explanation: The data members can be passed with help of object but only if the member is public. The object will obviously be used outside the class. The object must have access to the data member so that its value or reference is used outside the class which is possible only if the member is public.

mcqs.question: What exactly is passed when an object is passed by reference?

options.b: b) The original object class name
options.c: c) The exact address of the object in memory
options.d: d) The exact address of data members

mcqs.answer: c) The exact address of the object in memory
mcqs.explanation: The location of the object, that is, the exact memory location is passed, when the object is passed by reference. The pass by reference is actually a reference to the object that the function uses with another name to the same memory location as the original object uses.

mcqs.question: If the object is not to be passed to any function but the values of the object have to be used then?

options.a: a) The data members should be passed separately
options.b: b) The data members and member functions have to be passed separately
options.c: c) The values should be present in other variables
options.d: d) The object must be passed

mcqs.answer: a) The data members should be passed separately
mcqs.explanation: The data members can be passed separately. There is no need to pass whole object, instead we can use the object to pass only the required values.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) More than one object can’t be passed to a function
options.b: b) Any number of objects can be passed to a function
options.c: c) Objects can’t be passed, only data member values can be passed
options.d: d) Objects should be passed only if those are public in class

mcqs.answer: b) Any number of objects can be passed to a function
mcqs.explanation: There is no restriction on passing the number of objects to a function. The operating system or the compiler or environment may limit the number of arguments. But there is no limit on number of objects till that limit.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output if all necessary code is included (Header files and main function)? 
void test (Object &y)
{
    y = "It is a string";
}
void main()
{
	Object x = null;
	test (x);
	System.out.println (x);
}
mcqs.explanation: This is because the x object is passed by reference. The changes made inside the function will be applicable to original function too.

mcqs.question: In which type is new memory location will be allocated?

options.a: a) Only in pass by reference
options.b: b) Only in pass by value
options.c: c) Both in pass by reference and value

mcqs.answer: b) Only in pass by value
mcqs.explanation: The new memory location will be allocated only if the object is passed by value. Reference uses the same memory address and is denoted by another name also. But in pass by value, another object is created and new memory space is allocated for it.

mcqs.question: Pass by reference and pass by value can’t be done simultaneously in a single function argument list.
mcqs.explanation: There is no condition which specifies that only the reference pass or values pass is allowed. The argument list can contain one reference pass and another value pass. This helps to manipulate the objects with functions more easily.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Returning Objects”.

mcqs.question: In which of the following way(s) can the object be returned from a function?

options.a: a) Can only be returned by value
options.b: b) Can only be returned by reference
options.c: c) Can be returned either by value or reference
options.d: d) Can neither be returned by value nor by reference

mcqs.answer: c) Can be returned either by value or reference
mcqs.explanation: The objects can be returned either by value or reference. There is no mandatory condition for the way it should be used. The way of returning object can be decided based on the requirement.

mcqs.question: Whenever an object is returned by value ____________________

options.a: a) A temporary object is created
options.b: b) Temporary object is not created
options.c: c) Temporary object may or may not be created
options.d: d) New permanent object is created

mcqs.answer: a) A temporary object is created
mcqs.explanation: A temporary object is created when an object is returned by value. The temporary object is used to copy the values to another object or to be used in some way. The object holds all the values of the data members of the object.

mcqs.question: Where the temporary objects (created while return by value) are created?
mcqs.explanation: The temporary object are created within the function and are intended to return the value for specific use. Either the object can be assigned to another object or be used directly if possible.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for returning an object by value?
mcqs.explanation: The class name itself should be the return type of the function. This notifies that the function will return an object of specified class type. Only the class name should be specified.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for defining a function which passes an object by reference?
mcqs.explanation: The function declaration must contain the class name as return type. But, a & symbol should be followed by the class name. & indicates that the object being returned will be returned by reference.

mcqs.question: If an object is declared inside the function then ____________________ outside the function.

options.a: a) It can be returned by reference
options.b: b) It can’t be returned by reference
options.c: c) It can be returned by address
options.d: d) It can’t be returned at all

mcqs.answer: b) It can’t be returned by reference
mcqs.explanation: The object which is declared inside the class can never be returned by reference. This is because the object will be destroyed as it goes out of scope when the function is returned. The local variables get destroyed when function is returned hence the local objects can’t be returned by reference.

mcqs.question: How many independent objects can be returned at same time from a function?
mcqs.explanation: Only one object can be returned at a time. This is because a function is only capable of returning a single value at a time. Though array of objects can be returned from a function.

mcqs.question: Which error will be produced if a local object is returned by reference outside a function?
mcqs.explanation: If the local object is returned outside the function then the compile-time error arises. While the program is being converted and the processes happening during compile time, the compiler won’t be able to resolve the statement.

mcqs.question: If object is passed by reference ____________________

options.b: b) Temporary object is created inside the function
options.c: c) Temporary object is created for few seconds
options.d: d) Temporary object is not created

mcqs.answer: d) Temporary object is not created
mcqs.explanation: The temporary object is not created. If object is returned by reference, a particular memory location will be denoted with another name and hence same address values will be used.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is correct?

options.a: a) Individual data members can’t be returned
options.b: b) Individual data members can be returned
options.c: c) Individual member functions can be returned from another function
options.d: d) Individual data members can only be passed by reference

mcqs.answer: b) Individual data members can be returned
mcqs.explanation: It is not mandatory to return the whole object. Instead we can return a specific data member value. But the return type given must match with the data type of the data being returned.

mcqs.question: Can we return an array of objects?

options.b: b) Ye, only if objects are having same values
options.c: c) No, because objects contain many other values
options.d: d) No, because objects are single entity

mcqs.explanation: The Object array can be returned from a function. This can be done by putting a className* as the return type of the function. This makes the return type to accept an array of objects in return.

mcqs.question: If an object is passed by reference to a function then it must be returned by reference.
