mcqs.explanation: It is not compulsory to return the object in the same way as it was passed. If the object is passed by reference then there is actually no need to return the object. Because the changes made inside the function will be visible on the original object of caller function also.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Two objects can point to the same memory location
options.b: b) Two objects can never point to the same memory location
options.c: c) Objects not allowed to point at a location already occupied
options.d: d) Objects can’t point to any address

mcqs.answer: a) Two objects can point to the same memory location
mcqs.explanation: When an object is created and instead of calling a constructor, another object is assigned to it. Both the objects point to the same memory location. This can be illustrated with help of return by reference.

mcqs.question: If an object is being returned by value then __________________________

options.a: a) Its member values are made constant
options.b: b) Its member values have to be copied individually
options.c: c) Its member values are not used
options.d: d) Its member values are copied using copy constructor

mcqs.answer: d) Its member values are copied using copy constructor
mcqs.explanation: When an object is returned by value, it will be returned to another object or will be directly used. Still in all the conditions the copy constructor will be used to copy all the values from the temporary object that gets created.

mcqs.question: Why temporary object is not created in return by reference?

options.a: a) Because compiler can’t create temporary objects
options.b: b) Because the temporary object is created within the function
options.c: c) Because return by reference just make the objects points to values memory location
options.d: d) Because return by reference just make the object point to null

mcqs.answer: c) Because return by reference just make the objects points to values memory location
mcqs.explanation: A reference to the memory location where the returned object is stored is made. This allows the new object which takes the return value, point to the memory location and hence access the same values.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Assigning Objects”.

mcqs.question: When value of an object is assigned to another object ________________

options.b: b) Its values gets copied into another object
options.c: c) Its values gets address of the existing values
options.d: d) The compiler doesn’t execute that statement

mcqs.answer: b) Its values gets copied into another object
mcqs.explanation: The values get copied to another object. No address is assigned to the object values. This is uses copy constructor to copy the values.

mcqs.question: If an object is created and another object is assigned to it, then ________________

options.a: a) Copy constructor is called to copy the values
options.b: b) Object is copied directly to the object
options.c: c) Reference to another object is created
options.d: d) The new object is initialized to null values

mcqs.answer: c) Reference to another object is created
mcqs.explanation: The new object created, refers to the same address of the previously created object. Now whenever new object changes any data member value, it will affect the previously existing object.

mcqs.question: How the argument passed to a function get initialized?

options.a: a) Assigned using copy constructor at time of passing

mcqs.answer: a) Assigned using copy constructor at time of passing
mcqs.explanation: The arguments get initialized using the copy constructor. There is a need of assigning the value of all the members of an object to the local object of the function.

mcqs.question:
Predict the output of the program. 
class A
{
	public int i;
};
void main()
{
	A x;
	A y=x;
	x.i=10;
	y.i=20;
	y.i++;
	y.i=20;
	cout&l;<tx.i;
}
mcqs.explanation: The expected output may be 10 because the value of member of object x is printed. But when object x is assigned to y, y points to the same address where x is stored. So actually both objects x and y point to the same location and refers to the same object.

mcqs.question: If programmer doesn’t define any copy assignment operator then ____________________

options.b: b) Program fails at run time
options.c: c) Compiler gives an implicit definition
options.d: d) Compiler can’t copy the member values

mcqs.answer: c) Compiler gives an implicit definition
mcqs.explanation: While defining a copy constructor, we use reference const parameter, those are used for the assignment. The assignment operator may or may not be defined by the programmer, if not, compiler implicitly defines member wise copy assignment operator.

mcqs.question: Declaring a copy constructor doesn’t suppresses the compiler generated copy assignment operator.
mcqs.explanation: Even if the programmer doesn’t define or even if they define the copy constructor. The compiler still generates a copy assignment operator. It doesn’t gets suppressed.

mcqs.question: In copy constructor definition, if non const values are accepted only ________

options.a: a) Only const objects will be accepted
options.b: b) Only non – const objects are accepted
options.c: c) Only const members will not get copied

mcqs.answer: b) Only non – const objects are accepted
mcqs.explanation: Only the non – const objects will be accepted by the compiler. If a const object is passed, the compiler produces an error. To reduce that, we use const argument in definition, so that both const and non – const objects are accepted.

mcqs.question: How many objects can be assigned to a single address?
mcqs.explanation: The memory address can be referenced by more than one object. There is no maximum number defined. Any number of objects can reference to the same address.

mcqs.question: Use of assignment operator ____________________

options.a: a) Changes its use, when used at declaration and in normal assignment
options.b: b) Doesn’t changes its use, whatever the syntax might be
options.c: c) Assignment takes place in declaration and assignment syntax
options.d: d) Doesn’t work in normal syntax, but only with declaration

mcqs.answer: a) Changes its use, when used at declaration and in normal assignment
mcqs.explanation: The assignment operator if used at declaration then it uses copy constructor for the copying of objects. If used in simple assignment syntax then it uses copy assignment function.

mcqs.question: If more than one object refer to the same address, any changes made __________

options.a: a) Can be made visible to specific objects
options.b: b) Will be specific to one object only
options.c: c) From any object will be visible in all
options.d: d) Doesn’t changes the values of all objects

mcqs.answer: c) From any object will be visible in all
mcqs.explanation: At a memory address, only one object can be referenced. All the other objects which refer to the same memory address make changes for all of the objects referring that address.

mcqs.question: How to make more than one object refer to the same object?

options.b: b) Initialize the object with another at declaration
options.c: c) Use constructor to create new object

mcqs.answer: b) Initialize the object with another at declaration
mcqs.explanation: The object must get initialized with another object at time of declaration only. We don’t have to create a new object we just have to get name of new object because there after same address will be referred.

mcqs.question: We can assign ______________________

options.a: a) Value of one reference variable to another
options.b: b) Value of any object to another
options.c: c) Value of any type to any object
options.d: d) Value of non – reference to another reference

mcqs.answer: a) Value of one reference variable to another
mcqs.explanation: Only the reference value can be assigned to another reference value. This is because both deal with the address. There is no type mismatch hence we can assign them.

mcqs.question: Assigning reference to an object _________________

options.a: a) Will create another copy of the object
options.b: b) Will create two different copies of the object
options.c: c) Will not create any other copy of the object
options.d: d) Will not refer to the object

mcqs.answer: c) Will not create any other copy of the object
mcqs.explanation: When an object is assigned with another object. Same memory location is used. There is no other copy of the object created.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) We can use direct assignment for any object
options.b: b) We can use direct assignment only for different class objects
options.c: c) We must not use direct assignment
options.d: d) We can use direct assignment to same class objects

mcqs.answer: d) We can use direct assignment to same class objects
mcqs.explanation: The direct assignment can be used with the same class objects. There is no restriction on them. But better if the program have a predefined copy assignment operator.

mcqs.question: Assigning objects takes place while passing the arguments.
mcqs.explanation: The actual assignment doesn’t take place as the object might have got passed by reference. Also even if not by reference, the copy constructor is called to copy the values into the new object and not exactly the assignment operator.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Pointer to Objects”.

mcqs.question: Which language among the following doesn’t allow pointers?
mcqs.explanation: The concept of pointers is not supported in Java. The feature is not given in the language but can be used in some ways explicitly. Though this pointer is supported by java too.

mcqs.question: Which is correct syntax for declaring pointer to object?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax must contain * symbol after the className as the type of object. This declares an object pointer. This can store address of any object of the specified class.

mcqs.question: Which operator should be used to access the members of the class using object pointer?
mcqs.explanation: The members can be accessed from the object pointer by using arrow operator. The arrow operator can be used only with the pointer of class type. If simple object is declared, it must use dot operator to access the members.

mcqs.question: How does compiler decide the intended object to be used, if more than one object are used?
mcqs.explanation: This pointer denotes the object, in which it is being used. If member function is called with respect to one object then this pointer refers to the same object members. It can be used when members with same name are involved.

mcqs.question: If pointer to an object is declared __________

options.a: a) It can store any type of address
options.b: b) It can store only void addresses
options.c: c) It can only store address of integer type
options.d: d) It can only store object address of class type specified

mcqs.answer: d) It can only store object address of class type specified
mcqs.explanation: The address of only the specified class type can get their address stored in the object pointer. The addresses doesn’t differ but they do differ for the amount and type of memory required for objects of different classes. Hence same class object pointer should be used.

mcqs.question: What is the size of an object pointer?

options.a: a) Equal to size of any usual pointer
options.b: b) Equal to size of sum of all the members of object
options.c: c) Equal to size of maximum sized member of object
options.d: d) Equal to size of void

mcqs.answer: a) Equal to size of any usual pointer
mcqs.explanation: The size of object pointer is same as that of any usual pointer. This is because only the address have to be stored. There are no values to be stored in the pointer.

mcqs.question: A pointer _________________

options.a: a) Can point to only one object at a time
options.b: b) Can point to more than one objects at a time
options.c: c) Can point to only 2 objects at a time
options.d: d) Can point to whole class objects at a time

mcqs.answer: a) Can point to only one object at a time
mcqs.explanation: The object pointer can point to only one object at a time. The pointer will be able to store only one address at a time. Hence only one object can be referred.

mcqs.question: Pointer to a base class can be initialized with the address of derived class, because of _________

options.a: a) derived-to-base implicit conversion for pointers
options.b: b) base-to-derived implicit conversion for pointers
options.c: c) base-to-base implicit conversion for pointers
options.d: d) derived-to-derived implicit conversion for pointers

mcqs.answer: a) derived-to-base implicit conversion for pointers
mcqs.explanation: It is an implicit rule defined in most of the programming languages. It permits the programmer to declare a pointer to the derived class from a base class pointer. In this way the programmer doesn’t have to declare object for derived class each time it is required.

mcqs.question: Can pointers to object access the private members of the class?

options.b: b) Yes, only if it is only pointer to object
options.c: c) No, because objects can be referenced from another objects too

mcqs.explanation: The pointers to an object can never access the private members of the class outside the class. The object can indirectly use those private members using member functions which are public in the class.

mcqs.question: Is name of an array of objects is also a pointer to object?

options.c: c) No, because it represents more than one object

mcqs.explanation: The array name represents a pointer to the object. The name alone can represent the starting address of the array. But that also represents an array which is in turn stored in a pointer.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) The pointer to object can hold address only
options.b: b) The pointer can hold value of any type
options.c: c) The pointer can hold only void reference
options.d: d) The pointer can’t hold any value

mcqs.answer: a) The pointer to object can hold address only
mcqs.explanation: The pointer to an object can hold only the addresses. Address of any other object of same class. This allows the programmer to link more than one objects if required.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax to call a member function using pointer?
mcqs.explanation: The pointer should be mentioned followed by the arrow operator. Arrow operator is applicable only with the pointers. Then the function name should be mentioned that is to be called.

mcqs.question: If a pointer to an object is created and the object gets deleted without using the pointer then __________
mcqs.explanation: When the address pointed by the object pointer gets deleted, the pointer now points to an invalid address. Hence it becomes a dangling pointer. It can’t be null or void pointer since it doesn’t point to any specific location.

mcqs.question: How can the address stored in the pointer be retrieved?
mcqs.explanation: The & symbol must be used. This should be done such that the object should be preceded by & symbol and then the address should be stored in another variable. This is done to get the address where the object is stored.

mcqs.question: What should be done to prevent changes that may be made to the values pointed by the pointer?

options.a: a) Usual pointer can’t change the values pointed
options.b: b) Pointer should be made virtual
options.c: c) Pointer should be made anonymous
options.d: d) Pointer should be made const

mcqs.answer: d) Pointer should be made const
mcqs.explanation: The pointer should be declared as a const type. This prevents the pointer to change any value that is being pointed from it. This is a feature that is made to access the values using pointer but to make sure that pointer doesn’t change those values accidently.

mcqs.question: References to object are same as pointers of object.
mcqs.explanation: The references are made to object when the object is created and initialized with another object without calling any constructor. But the object pointer must be declared explicitly using * symbol that will be capable of storing some address. Hence both are different.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “This Pointer”.

mcqs.question: Which is the pointer which denotes the object calling the member function?
mcqs.explanation: The pointer which denotes the object calling the member function is known as this pointer. The this pointer is usually used when there are members in the function with same name as those of the class members.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) this pointer is passed implicitly when member functions are called
options.b: b) this pointer is passed explicitly when member functions are called
options.c: c) this pointer is passed with help of pointer member functions are called
options.d: d) this pointer is passed with help of void pointer member functions are called

mcqs.answer: a) this pointer is passed implicitly when member functions are called
mcqs.explanation: When an object calls some member function, it implicitly passes itself as an argument. This allows the compiler to know which member should be used for the purposes. This also allows to reduce the ambiguity among the variable and data member names.

mcqs.question: The this pointer is accessible __________________

options.a: a) Within all the member functions of the class
options.b: b) Only within functions returning void
options.d: d) Within the member functions with zero arguments

mcqs.explanation: The this pointer is available only within the non-static member functions of a class. If the member function is static, it will be common to all the objects and hence a single object can’t refer to those functions independently.

mcqs.question: An object’s this pointer _____________________

options.d: d) Isn’t part of object itself

mcqs.answer: d) Isn’t part of object itself
mcqs.explanation: The object’s this pointer being called are not part of the object itself. This can be cross verified by checking that it doesn’t take up any space for the data to be stored or pointed.

mcqs.question: The result of sizeof() function __________________

options.a: a) Includes space reserved for this pointer
options.b: b) Includes space taken up by the address pointer by this pointer
options.c: c) Doesn’t include the space taken by this pointer
options.d: d) Doesn’t include space for any data member

mcqs.answer: c) Doesn’t include the space taken by this pointer
mcqs.explanation: The space taken by this pointer is not reflected in by the sizeof() operator. This is because object’s this pointer is not part of object itself. This is a cross verification for the concept stating that this pointer doesn’t take any space in the object.

mcqs.question: Whenever non-static member functions are called _______________

options.a: a) Address of the object is passed implicitly as an argument
options.b: b) Address of the object is passed explicitly as an argument
options.c: c) Address is specified globally so that the address is not used again
options.d: d) Address is specified as return type of the function

mcqs.answer: a) Address of the object is passed implicitly as an argument
mcqs.explanation: The address is passed implicitly as an argument to the function. This doesn’t have to be passed explicitly. The address is passed, of the object which is calling the non-static member function.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct interpretation of the member function call from an object, object.function(parameter);
mcqs.explanation: The function name is specified first and then the parameter lists. The parameter list is included with the object name along with & symbol. This denotes that the address of the object is being passed as an argument.

mcqs.question: The address of the object _________________

options.a: a) Can’t be accessed from inside the function
options.b: b) Can’t be accessed in the program
options.c: c) Is available inside the member function using this pointer
options.d: d) Can be accessed using the object name inside the member function

mcqs.answer: c) Is available inside the member function using this pointer
mcqs.explanation: The address of the object with respect to which the member functions are being called, are stored in this pointer. This pointer is hence used whenever there are members with same name as those of the variables inside the function.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) This pointer can be used to guard against any kind of reference
options.b: b) This pointer can be used to guard against self-reference
options.c: c) This pointer can be used to guard from other pointers
options.d: d) This pointer can be used to guard from parameter referencing

mcqs.answer: b) This pointer can be used to guard against self-reference
mcqs.explanation: The this pointer can be used to guard itself whenever self-reference is used. This allows accidental address access. And accidental modification of data.

mcqs.question: Which syntax doesn’t execute/is false when executed?
mcqs.explanation: The condition becomes false when executed and hence doesn’t executes. This is the case where this pointer can guard itself from the self-reference. Here if the address of the object doesn’t match with this pointer that means the object doesn’t refer itself.

mcqs.question: The this pointers _____________________

options.b: b) Can be assigned any value

mcqs.explanation: The this pointer is non modifiable. This is because the address of any object remains constant throughout its life time. Hence the address must not be changed otherwise wrong members of invalid addresses might get accessed.

mcqs.question: Earlier implementations of C++ ___________________

options.a: a) Never allowed assignment to this pointer
options.b: b) Allowed no assignment to this pointer
options.c: c) Allowed assignments to this pointer
options.d: d) Never allowed assignment to any pointer

mcqs.answer: c) Allowed assignments to this pointer
mcqs.explanation: The earlier, most initial versions of C++ used to allow assignments to this pointers. That used to allow modifications of this pointer. Later that feature got disabled.

mcqs.question: This pointer can be used directly to ___________

options.a: a) To manipulate self-referential data structures
options.b: b) To manipulate any reference to pointers to member functions
options.d: d) To manipulate and disable any use of pointers

mcqs.answer: a) To manipulate self-referential data structures
mcqs.explanation: This is a feature provided, that can be used directly. The manipulation of self-referential data structures is just an application of this feature. Other conditions fails as this pointer doesn’t deal with those things.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is/are type(s) of this pointer?
mcqs.explanation: The this pointer can be declared const or volatile. This depends on need of program and type of code. This is just an additional feature.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for declaring the type of this in a member function?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax contains the cv-qualifier-list that can be determined from the member function declaratory that can be either const or volatile or can be made both. Hence we write it as list. classType denotes the name of class to mention to which class does the object belong to. And *const this denotes that the this pointer is having a constant value.

title: 15. OOPs MCQ on Default Arguments vs Overloading, Upcasting and Downcasting

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Default Arguments”.

mcqs.question: What are default arguments?

options.a: a) Arguments which are not mandatory to be passed
options.b: b) Arguments with default value that aren’t mandatory to be passed
options.c: c) Arguments which are not passed to functions
options.d: d) Arguments which always take same data value

mcqs.answer: b) Arguments with default value that aren’t mandatory to be passed
mcqs.explanation: The arguments which are assigned with some default value. Since some value is already given, it is not mandatory to pass those arguments. They can be used directly.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct condition for the default arguments?

options.a: a) Those must be declared as last arguments in argument list
options.b: b) Those must be declared first in the argument list
options.c: c) Those can be defined anywhere in the argument list
options.d: d) Those are declared inside the function definition

mcqs.answer: a) Those must be declared as last arguments in argument list
mcqs.explanation: The default arguments must be declared at last in the argument list. This is to ensure that the arguments doesn’t create ambiguity. The normal arguments should be passed first.

mcqs.question: If a member function have to be made both zero argument and parameterized constructor, which among the following can be the best option?

options.a: a) Two normal and one default argument
options.b: b) At least one default argument
options.d: d) Make all the arguments default

mcqs.answer: d) Make all the arguments default
mcqs.explanation: All the arguments must be made default. This will make sure that none of the arguments are mandatory to be passed. Which in turn means that the function can work without any argument and can be passed with arguments too.

mcqs.question: Which among the following function can be called without arguments?

options.a: a) void add(int x, int y=0)
options.c: c) void add(int x=0, int y=0)

mcqs.answer: c) void add(int x=0, int y=0)
mcqs.explanation: For the function to be called without arguments, either it must have zero arguments or it must have all the default arguments. Here the function in option void add(int x=0, int y=0) have all the default arguments and hence can be called directly with zero argument.

mcqs.question: If a function have all the default arguments but still some values are passed to the function then ______________

options.a: a) The function will use the values passed to it
options.b: b) The function will use the default values as those are local
options.c: c) The function can use any value whichever is higher
options.d: d) The function will choose the minimum values

mcqs.answer: a) The function will use the values passed to it
mcqs.explanation: The function will use the values passed explicitly to it. The default values will be ignored. The default values are used only in case the values are not passed explicitly to the function.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is correct?

options.a: a) void test(int x=0, int y, int z=0)
options.c: c) void test(int x, int y=0)
options.d: d) void test(int x=’c, int y)

mcqs.answer: c) void test(int x, int y=0)
mcqs.explanation: The default arguments must be mentioned at last in the argument list. Also, the type of values assigned must match with the argument type. All the default arguments must be mentioned at last, none of the normal arguments should come in between the default arguments list.

mcqs.question: What function will be called with the independent syntax “test(5,6,7);”?

options.a: a) void test(int x, int y)
options.b: b) void test(int x=0, int y, int z)
options.c: c) int test(int x=0, y=0, z=0)
options.d: d) void test(int x, int y, int z=0)

mcqs.answer: d) void test(int x, int y, int z=0)
mcqs.explanation: There are three arguments that are getting passed to the function test(). Only the last option have all the default argument at last in the argument list. And the total number of the arguments is three. The third option is wrong because the return type is int and the syntax given is independent which means it doesn’t return any value.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a wrong call to the function void test(int x, int y=0, int z=0)?
mcqs.explanation: The function must be passed with at least one argument. There is two default arguments and one normal argument which must be passed with some value. Hence the third call to the function is wrong as it doesn’t pass even a single parameter to the function

mcqs.question: Default arguments are _________________________

options.a: a) Only allowed in the parameter list of the function declaration
options.b: b) Only allowed in the return type of the function declaration
options.c: c) Only allowed with the class name definition
options.d: d) Only allowed with the integer type values

mcqs.answer: a) Only allowed in the parameter list of the function declaration
mcqs.explanation: The default arguments are only allowed in the parameter list of the function arguments. This rule was not applicable in the beginning versions of c++ but later from c++ 14th version it has been implemented. This is the only way to use default arguments.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is false for default arguments?

options.a: a) Those are not allowed with a declaration of pointer to functions
options.b: b) Those are not allowed with the reference to functions
options.c: c) Those are not allowed with the typedef declarations
options.d: d) Those are allowed with pointer and reference to function declaration

mcqs.answer: d) Those are allowed with pointer and reference to function declaration
mcqs.explanation: The statements given are true because that is a feature given to make the programming more flexible and have some security with accidental changes at same time. The last option is false because it is not a rule defined. It is an opposite statement to the rules defined for default arguments.

mcqs.question: The non-template functions can be added with default arguments to already declared functions ____________________

options.a: a) If and only if the function is declared again in the same scope
options.b: b) If and only if the function is declared only once in the same scope
options.c: c) If and only if the function is declared in different scope
options.d: d) If and only if the function is declared twice in the program

mcqs.answer: a) If and only if the function is declared again in the same scope
mcqs.explanation: The non-template functions can also be added with default arguments. This can be done even if the functions were defined earlier. This is because the call to the function won’t be affected. The function can still be used in the same way as it was used earlier.

mcqs.question: The using declaration __________

options.a: a) Doesn’t carry over the default values
options.b: b) Carries over the known default arguments
options.c: c) Carries over only the normal arguments
options.d: d) Carries over only few default arguments

mcqs.answer: b) Carries over the known default arguments
mcqs.explanation: The using-declaration carries over all the known default arguments. This is a common feature as the usage doesn’t gets affected even if the default arguments are added. This comes under flexible programming.

mcqs.question: The names given to the default arguments are only looked up and ________________ and are bound during declaration.
mcqs.explanation: The names given to the default arguments are bound at time of declaration but are only checked for accessibility and to get bounded. This is mainly to bind those members during declaration.

mcqs.question: The default argument get bound during declaration ________________

options.c: c) But are executed only if priority is given
options.d: d) But are executed during function call

mcqs.answer: d) But are executed during function call
mcqs.explanation: The default argument are bound at the time of declaration. That is an implicit functioning. But those are executed only when the function is called. Otherwise, those will never get executed.

mcqs.question: The virtual function overrides ____________

options.a: a) Do not acquire base class declaration of default arguments
options.b: b) Do acquire base class declaration of default arguments
options.c: c) Do not link with the default arguments of base class
options.d: d) Do link with the default argument but only of derived classes

mcqs.answer: a) Do not acquire base class declaration of default arguments
mcqs.explanation: The virtual function overrides do not acquire the base class declaration of default arguments. Even if a call to the virtual function is made, static type of the object decides the default arguments to be used.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Constructors Overloading”.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for constructors overloading?

options.b: b) Constructors can be overloaded using different signatures
options.c: c) Constructors can be overloaded with same signatures
options.d: d) Constructors can be overloaded with different return types

mcqs.answer: b) Constructors can be overloaded using different signatures
mcqs.explanation: The constructors can be overloaded only if the definitions have different signatures. Constructors doesn’t have any return type so can’t be overloaded using return type. If constructors have same signature then it will produce a compile time error.

mcqs.question: If a constructors should be capable of creating objects without argument and with arguments, which is a good alternative for this purpose?

options.b: b) Use constructor with one parameter
options.c: c) Use constructor with all default arguments

mcqs.answer: c) Use constructor with all default arguments
mcqs.explanation: The constructor should use all the default arguments. This will allow the constructor to be called even if no arguments are passed. And if arguments are passed, those will be accepted instead of the default values.

mcqs.question: The Constructors with all the default arguments are similar as default constructors.
mcqs.explanation: The constructors with all the default arguments are similar as the default constructors. Those can be used instead of the default constructors. So defining the default constructor is not mandatory.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) The constructors overloading can be done by using different names
options.b: b) The constructors overloading can be done by using different return types
options.c: c) The constructors can be overloaded by using only one argument
options.d: d) The constructors must have the same name as that of class

mcqs.answer: d) The constructors must have the same name as that of class
mcqs.explanation: The constructors must have the same name as that of the class name. This is mandatory because only the constructor functions doesn’t have any return type. Also, for overloading all the functions must have the same name.

mcqs.question: Which among the following can be used in place of default constructor?
mcqs.explanation: For a parameterized constructor to be used as a default constructor, it must have all the default arguments. This makes the constructor to have optional arguments which are not mandatory to be passed.

mcqs.question: Can a class have more than one function with all the default arguments?

options.b: b) Yes, if argument list is different
options.c: c) No, because constructors overloading doesn’t depend on argument list

mcqs.explanation: A single class can never have more than once constructor with all the default arguments. This is because it will make all those constructors as a default constructor. And when an object is created with zero arguments then it will create ambiguity.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for using default arguments with the constructor?
mcqs.explanation: The constructors using the default arguments must initialize the arguments in the argument list. This is to make the constructor use the default value when no arguments are passed. If no arguments are listed then it is a default constructor.

mcqs.question: How many parameters must be passed if only the following prototype is given to a constructor? Prototype: className(int x, int y, int z=0);
mcqs.explanation: In the prototype given, only 2 arguments are mandatory. Since the third argument is default argument, so it is not mandatory to pass the argument.

mcqs.question: If the constructors are overloaded by using the default arguments, which problem may arise?

options.a: a) The constructors might have all the same arguments except the default arguments
options.b: b) The constructors might have same return type
options.c: c) The constructors might have same number of arguments
options.d: d) The constructors can’t be overloaded with respect to default arguments

mcqs.answer: a) The constructors might have all the same arguments except the default arguments
mcqs.explanation: The constructors having same arguments except the default arguments can give rise to errors. If only the mandatory arguments are passed, it will create ambiguity in calling the correct constructor. Hence the mandatory arguments must be different.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) More than one constructors with all default arguments is allowed
options.b: b) More than one constructors with all default arguments can be defined outside the class
options.c: c) More than one constructors can be used with same argument list
options.d: d) More than one constructors with all default arguments can’t exist in same class

mcqs.answer: d) More than one constructors with all default arguments can’t exist in same class
mcqs.explanation: The constructors must have different argument list. Along that, if all the arguments are default arguments, there can’t be more than once constructor like that in the same class as that will create ambiguity while constructors are being called.

mcqs.question: Which constructor among the following will be called if a call is made like className(5,’a’);?

options.b: b) int className(int x, char c, char d);
options.c: c) className(int x, char c, int y);

mcqs.explanation: The syntax given is passing two parameters to the constructor call. One value is of integer type and another of character type. Hence the constructor with arguments of int and char type should be called. There is only one option that first accepts integer value and then a character value. Hence that constructor will be called.

mcqs.question: Which constructor definition will produce a compile time error?
mcqs.explanation: The default arguments, just like with member functions, must be listed at last in the argument list. Hence this will produce a compile time error. The compiler doesn’t allow the definition to be executed.

mcqs.question: If there is a constructor with all the default arguments and arguments are not passed then _________________

options.a: a) The default values given will not be used
options.b: b) Then all the null values will be used
options.c: c) Then all the default values given will be used
options.d: d) Then compiler will produce an error

mcqs.answer: c) Then all the default values given will be used
mcqs.explanation: The constructors will use the default values listed for use. The null values are not used because those are not specified. Though if it was compiler provided default constructor, then it would have initialized the members to null or zero values.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct statement for default constructors?

options.a: a) The constructors with all the default arguments
options.b: b) The constructors with all the null and zero values
options.c: c) The constructors which can’t be defined by programmer
options.d: d) The constructors with zero arguments

mcqs.answer: d) The constructors with zero arguments
mcqs.explanation: The closest answer to the question is that a default constructor is a constructor with zero arguments. But this is not the actual case. Actually the constructors provided by the compiler are default constructors. And the constructors with zero arguments defined by the programmer are zero argument constructors.

mcqs.question: Which is a good alternative instead of having one zero argument constructor and one single argument constructor with default argument?

options.d: d) Using one constructor with two arguments

mcqs.explanation: The constructor with one default argument can be the best alternative. This is because the constructor with one default value will do the work for both the default constructor and one argument constructor.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Upcasting”.

mcqs.question: What is upcasting?

options.b: b) Casting super type to subtype
options.c: c) Casting subtype to super type and vice versa
options.d: d) Casting anytype to any other type

mcqs.explanation: The upcasting concept includes only the casting of subtypes to the super types. This casting is generally done implicitly. Smaller size types can fit into larger size types implicitly.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for upcasting in inheritance?

options.a: a) Downward to the inheritance tree
options.b: b) Upward to the inheritance tree

mcqs.answer: b) Upward to the inheritance tree
mcqs.explanation: The upcasting concept in inheritance is always applied upward the inheritance tree. The derived class objects can be type casted to any of its parent class type. Since is a relationship applies in general inheritance.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is safe?

options.d: d) If upcasting is safe then downcasting is not, and vice versa

mcqs.explanation: The upcasting is always safe since the derived type or the smaller type is converted into the base type or the larger size. This results in allocating a smaller size data into bigger type data. No data is lost in casting, hence safe.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is the best situation to use upcasting?

options.a: a) For general code dealing with only subtype
options.b: b) For general code dealing with only supertype
options.c: c) For general code dealing with both the supertype and subtype
options.d: d) For writing a rigid code with respect to subtype

mcqs.answer: b) For general code dealing with only supertype
mcqs.explanation: When a general code has to be written where we use only the supertype object or the data of bigger size, then upcasting would be the best option. Since the whole code will require only the supertype name references.

mcqs.question: Which property is shown most when upcasting is used?
mcqs.explanation: The code written using upcasting mostly shows complex code in simpler syntax features. This is because the upcasting concept can be applied as polymorphism and to group the similar type of objects.

mcqs.question: Upcasting and downcasting objects are the same as casting primitive types.
mcqs.explanation: It is a bit confusing concept since both casting concepts are different. Primitive casting depends on the type and size of data being typecast. Whereas in objects casting, the classes and inheritance order plays a big role.

mcqs.question:
Which casting among the following is allowed for the code given below? 
class A
{
	public :int a;
}
class B:public A
{
	int b;
}
main()
{
	B b=new A();  //casting 1
	A a=new B();  //casting 2
}
mcqs.explanation: The casting 2 is correct. The objects casting must be done from derived class object to a parent class object. That is, the object of the superclass can be made an object of subclass only. Vice versa is not possible.

mcqs.question: If multiple inheritance is implemented, which upcasting will be correct?

options.a: a) Upcast to first base class listed in inheritance
options.b: b) Upcast to send base class listed in inheritance
options.c: c) Upcast to any base class

mcqs.answer: c) Upcast to any base class
mcqs.explanation: The upcasting of derived class object is possible to any base class. This is because the base class object can represent any of its derived classes using upcasting.

mcqs.question: If class C inherits class B and class B inherits class A ________________

options.a: a) Class C object can be upcasted to object of class B only
options.b: b) Class C object can be upcasted to object of class A only
options.c: c) Class C object can be upcasted to object of either class A or B
options.d: d) Class C object can’t be upcasted

mcqs.answer: c) Class C object can be upcasted to object of either class A or B
mcqs.explanation: Both class A and B are parent classes of class C. Class C object hence can be upcasted to any of those class objects. It is not compulsory to upcast to nearest parent.

mcqs.question: Upcasting is _____________________ without an explicit type cast.

options.a: a) Always allowed for public inheritance
options.b: b) Always allowed for protected inheritance
options.c: c) Always allowed for private inheritance

mcqs.answer: a) Always allowed for public inheritance
mcqs.explanation: The public inheritance shows the most flexible is-a relationship. Hence explicit type casting is not required. Implicit type casting is done by the compiler.

mcqs.question: Which concept is needed because of implicit type casting use?
mcqs.explanation: Since the implicit type casting allows casting of a base class pointer to refer to its derived class object or even base class object. We need dynamic type casting so that the references can be resolved during execution of program.

mcqs.question: When are the pointer types known for upcasting the objects?

options.d: d) Doesn’t apply to pointer types

mcqs.explanation: The pointer or reference types are known at compile time for the upcasting of an object. This is because the addresses must be known for casting the derived class to base class object.

mcqs.question: When are the object type known for upcasting the objects?

options.d: d) Doesn’t apply to objects directly

mcqs.explanation: The upcasting with objects directly requires runtime resolving. The objects are fixed and address are allocated at compile time. But the execution of a program requires runtime knowledge of object types, for implicit type cast.

mcqs.question: If two classes are defined “Parent” and “Child” then which is the correct type upcast syntax in C++?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax must contain the base class name first. So that the parent class object pointer can be declared. Then the object is assigned with the derived class object with & symbol. & symbol is added to get the address of the derived class object.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) Upcasting is possible only for single level inheritance
options.b: b) Upcasting is possible only for multilevel inheritance
options.c: c) Upcasting is possible only for multiple inheritance
options.d: d) Upcasting is possible for any type of inheritance

mcqs.answer: d) Upcasting is possible for any type of inheritance
mcqs.explanation: The type of inheritance doesn’t matter with the upcasting concept. Upcasting applies to all types of inheritance. Any derived class object can be upcasted to any of its base class object.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Downcasting”.

mcqs.question: What is downcasting?

options.c: c) Casting subtype to supertype and vice versa
options.d: d) Casting anytype to any other type

mcqs.explanation: The downcasting concept includes only the casting of supertypes to the sub types. This casting is generally done explicitly. Larger size types are made to fit into small size types explicitly.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a mandatory condition for downcasting?

options.a: a) It must not be done explicitly
options.b: b) It must be done implicitly
options.c: c) It must be done explicitly
options.d: d) It can’t be done explicitly

mcqs.answer: c) It must be done explicitly
mcqs.explanation: The downcasting of any object must be done explicitly. This is because the compilers don’t support the implicit conversion of a supertype to subtype.

mcqs.question: Downcasting is _______________________
mcqs.explanation: The downcasting concept is made for exception cases. When there is a need to represent an entity in the form which is not suitable for it. Representing a base type in derived type is not right but can be done for special cases.

mcqs.question: Downcasting ____________________

options.a: a) Can result in unexpected results
options.b: b) Can’t result in unexpected result
options.c: c) Can result only in out of memory error
options.d: d) Can’t result in any error

mcqs.answer: a) Can result in unexpected results
mcqs.explanation: The result of downcasting can be unexpected. This is because downcasting is done on the objects into the objects which doesn’t contain any information of data in lateral object.

mcqs.question: What should be used for safe downcast?
mcqs.explanation: The dynamic cast can be done using the operator dynamic_cast. This converts one type to another type in a safe way.

mcqs.question: What does dynamic_cast return after successful type casting?

options.a: a) Address of object which is converted
options.b: b) Address of object that is used for conversion
options.c: c) Address of object that is mentioned in the syntax

mcqs.answer: a) Address of object which is converted
mcqs.explanation: The address of the object which is converted is returned by the dynamic_cast operator. This is done to safely convert the subtype to supertype. This ensures the proper assignment and conversion from one type to another.

mcqs.question: If dynamic_cast fails, which value is returned?
mcqs.explanation: The null pointer is returned by the dynamic_cast, if it fails. The conversion sometimes fails because of too complex type conversion. The conversion may also fail due to memory or some related issues.

mcqs.question: Which is the proper syntax of dynamic_cast?
mcqs.explanation: The dynamic_cast is the name of the operator, which is followed by the new type in which the object have to be converted. Then the object name is given. This object name is then used after the type conversion.

mcqs.question: Which is the exception handler for the exceptions of downcasting?
mcqs.explanation: The exception handler for the exceptions produced during the downcasting exception. This handler can be called during runtime to handle any exception thrown.

mcqs.question: How to prevent the ClassCastExceptions?

options.c: c) By using arrow operator with check function
options.d: d) By checking type of conversion

mcqs.explanation: The instanceof operator can be used to check the compatibility of the conversion. This has to be done to check whether the casting would be safe or not.

mcqs.question: Java supports direct downcasting.
mcqs.explanation: The downcasting is not possible in java directly. This has to be done explicitly. The downcasting is not safe but can be checked for safe casting using instanceof function.

mcqs.question: Which way the downcasting is possible with respect to inheritance?

options.c: c) Either upward or downward the inheritance order
options.d: d) Order of inheritance doesn’t matter

mcqs.explanation: The downcasting is always downward the inheritance order. Since the base class object have to be casted into derived class type. This is a basic definition of downcasting.

mcqs.question: What happens when downcasting is done but not explicitly defined in syntax?
mcqs.explanation: The implicit downcasting is not possible. If tried, the compiler produces an error. Since the compiler doesn’t allow coasting to a type that is not compatible.

mcqs.question: When is the downcasting used?

options.a: a) To separate inherited class from base class
options.b: b) To write a more complex code
options.d: d) To disable one class in inheritance

mcqs.explanation: The downcasting can be used whenever there is a need to compare one object to another. Equals() function can be used to compare whether the objects were of same age. We can use getClass() function too.

mcqs.question: Why is downcasting possible in any language?

options.a: a) Because inheritance follows has-a relationship
options.b: b) Because inheritance follows is-a relationship
options.c: c) Because inheritance doesn’t follow any relationship
options.d: d) Because inheritance is not involved in casting

mcqs.answer: b) Because inheritance follows is-a relationship
mcqs.explanation: The downcasting is possible because the classes in inheritance follow is-a relationship. Hence the derived class is a base class. Which in turn make the downcasting possible.

title: 16. OOPs MCQ on Memory Allocation & Scope of Variable

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “New Operator”.

mcqs.question: What is the new operator?

options.a: a) Allocates memory for an object or array
options.b: b) Allocates memory for an object or array and returns a particular pointer
options.c: c) Used as return type when an object is created
options.d: d) Used to declare any new thing in a program

mcqs.answer: b) Allocates memory for an object or array and returns a particular pointer
mcqs.explanation: The new keyword is used to allocate memory of an object or array. The new object or array can be of any type. Then it returns a suitable non zero pointer to the object.

mcqs.question: Microsoft C++ Components extensions support new keyword to _____________

options.b: b) Replace a vtable slot entry
options.c: c) Add new vtable slot entries

mcqs.answer: c) Add new vtable slot entries
mcqs.explanation: The new keyword is used for adding new vtable slot entries. This is an additional feature in Microsoft C++. It can use predefined class object for this work.

mcqs.question: What happens when new fails?

options.c: c) Either throws an exception or returns zero

mcqs.answer: c) Either throws an exception or returns zero
mcqs.explanation: While creating new objects, the new operator may fail because of memory errors or due to permissions. At that moment the new operator returns zero or it may throw an exception. The exception can be handled as usual.

mcqs.question: If new throws an error, which function can be called to write a custom exception handler?
mcqs.explanation: If the default exception handler has to be replaced by a user defined handler, we can call _set_new_handler run-time library function with the function name as an argument. This lets the programmer to give a custom definition for handling new operator failure.

mcqs.question: In C++, if new operator is used, when is the constructor called?

options.a: a) Before the allocation of memory
options.b: b) After the allocation of memory
options.c: c) Constructor is called to allocate memory

mcqs.answer: b) After the allocation of memory
mcqs.explanation: The constructor function is called after the allocation of memory. In C++ the feature works in a bit different way. The memory for all the data members is allocated first and then the constructor function is called to finalize the memory allocated.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is correct syntax to declare a 2D array using new operator?
mcqs.explanation: The new operator usage to declare a 2D array requires a pointer and size of array to be declared. Data type and then the pointer with size of array. The left index can be left blank or any variable can be assigned to it.

mcqs.question: For declaring data by using new operator ____________________

options.a: a) Type name can’t contain const
options.b: b) Type name can’t contain volatile
options.c: c) Type name can’t contain class declarations
options.d: d) Type name can’t contain const, volatile, class declaration or enumerations

mcqs.answer: d) Type name can’t contain const, volatile, class declaration or enumerations
mcqs.explanation: The declaration of any data where we use new operator, any of the mentioned types are not allowed. This is because the new operator allocated memory based on the type of data which can be allocated dynamically.

mcqs.question: The new operator _____________

options.a: a) Can allocate reference types too
options.c: c) Can allocate reference to objects

mcqs.explanation: The new operator doesn’t allocate reference types. This is because the reference types are not objects. The new operator is used to allocate memory to the direct objects.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true?

options.a: a) New operator can’t allocate functions but pointer to functions can be allocated
options.b: b) New operator can allocate functions as well as pointer to functions
options.c: c) New operator can allocate any type of functions
options.d: d) New operator is not applicable with functions allocation

mcqs.answer: a) New operator can’t allocate functions but pointer to functions can be allocated
mcqs.explanation: The new operator can’t allocate functions but can allocate pointer to the functions. This is a security feature as well as to reduce the ambiguity in code. The new keyword is not given functionality to directly allocate any function.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is added in grammar of new operator?
mcqs.explanation: The new operator grammar is added with an initializer field. This can be used to initialize an object with a user defined constructor. Hence can allocate memory as intended by the programmer.

mcqs.question: Initializers __________________

options.a: a) Are used for specifying arrays
options.b: b) Are used to defined multidimensional arrays
options.c: c) Can’t be specified for arrays
options.d: d) Can’t be specified for any data

mcqs.answer: c) Can’t be specified for arrays
mcqs.explanation: The initializers can’t be specified for arrays. The initializers can create arrays of object if and only if the class has a default constructor. That is a zero argument constructor so that it can be called without any argument.

mcqs.question: The objects allocated using new operator ________________

options.a: a) Are destroyed when they go out of scope
options.b: b) Are not destroyed even if they go out of scope
options.d: d) Are not destroyed throughout the program execution

mcqs.answer: b) Are not destroyed even if they go out of scope
mcqs.explanation: It is not necessary that the objects get destroyed when they go out of scope if allocated by using new operator. This is because new operator returns a pointer to object that it had allocated. A suitable pointer with proper scope should be defined by the programmer explicitly.

mcqs.question: The new operator _________________

options.b: b) Doesn’t invoke function operator new
options.c: c) Invokes function operator only if required
options.d: d) Can’t invoke function operator new implicitly

mcqs.explanation: The new operator invokes function operator new. This is done to allocate the storage to an object. ::operator new is called for storage allocation implicitly.

mcqs.question: If a new operator is defined for a class and still global new operator have to be used, which operator should be used with the keyword new?
mcqs.explanation: As usual, scope resolution operator is used to get the scope of parent or the global entities. Hence we can use scope resolution operator with the new operator to call the global new operator even if new operator is defined for the class explicitly.

mcqs.question: How does compiler convert “::operator new” implicitly?

options.c: c) new operator :: type sizeof( type )

mcqs.explanation: The compiler implicitly converts the syntax so that the instruction can be understood by the processor and proper machine code can be generated. The conversion is done implicitly and no explicit syntax is required.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Delete Operator”.

mcqs.question: What is a delete operator?

options.a: a) Deallocates a block of memory
options.c: c) Deallocates only primitive data memory
options.d: d) Deallocates all the data reserved for a class

mcqs.answer: a) Deallocates a block of memory
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator is the reverse process of a new operator. It deallocates all the memory allocated for an object. The object can be of any type. The delete operator completely destroys an object so that the resources can be used for other purposes.

mcqs.question: If an object is allocated using new operator ____________

options.a: a) It should be deleted using delete operator
options.b: b) It can’t be deleted using delete operator
options.c: c) It may or may not be deleted using delete operator
options.d: d) The delete operator is not applicable

mcqs.answer: a) It should be deleted using delete operator
mcqs.explanation: The new operator allocates an object in memory and hence the memory allocation is bit different from usual allocation of an object. The delete operator can be used to delete the memory allocated for an object.

mcqs.question: Does delete return any value?
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator doesn’t return any value. Its function is to delete the memory allocated for an object. This is done in reverse way as that new operator works.

mcqs.question: Which type of value has resulted from the delete operator?
mcqs.explanation: The result of the delete operator is void. The values returned is of no use to the program or any other system function hence the return type is not defined for the delete operator.

mcqs.question: If delete is used to delete an object which was not allocated using new _______________

options.a: a) Then out of memory error arises
options.b: b) Then unreachable code error arises
options.c: c) Then unpredictable errors may arise
options.d: d) Then undefined variable error arises

mcqs.answer: c) Then unpredictable errors may arise
mcqs.explanation: When the delete operator is used with the objects that were not allocated using new operator then unpredictable errors may arise. This is because the delete can’t perform the required actions on the type of memory allocated for the object.

mcqs.question: Delete operator _________________

options.a: a) Can be used on pointers with null value
options.b: b) Can be used on pointers with void value
options.c: c) Can be used on pointer with value 0
options.d: d) Can be used on pointer with any value

mcqs.answer: c) Can be used on pointer with value 0
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator can be used on pointers with the value 0. This actually means that when new operator fails and return value 0 then deleting the result of failed new remains harmless. Hence the deletion is possible.

mcqs.question: When delete operator is used ___________________ (If object has a destructor)

options.a: a) Object destructor is called after deallocation
options.b: b) Object destructor is called before deallocation
options.c: c) Object destructor is not used
options.d: d) Object destructor can be called anytime during destruction

mcqs.answer: b) Object destructor is called before deallocation
mcqs.explanation: The destructor is called before the memory is deallocated for any object. The destructor call initiates the destruction process and the deallocation of memory takes place.

mcqs.question: If delete is applied to an object whose l-value is modifiable, then _______________ after the object is deleted.

options.a: a) Its value is defined as null
options.b: b) Its value is defined as void
options.c: c) Its value is defined as 0

mcqs.explanation: After performing delete operation on an object whole l-value is modifiable, its values becomes undefined. This is done so as to denote that the memory space is available to be used for other purposes.

mcqs.question: How many variants of delete operator are available?
mcqs.explanation: There are two variants of delete operator. One is for object deletion. Other is for deletion of object array.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax to delete a single object?
mcqs.explanation: The object to be deleted is mentioned after the keyword delete. This deletes the object from memory and free up the memory that was acquired by the object.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax to delete an array of objects?
mcqs.explanation: The object array that has to be deleted is mentioned after the keyword delete. But after delete, empty square brackets have to be given to denote that the deletion have to be done on array of objects.

mcqs.question: Which cases among the following produces the undefined result?

options.a: a) delete [] on an independent object
options.b: b) delete on an object array
options.c: c) delete [] on an object and delete on object array
options.d: d) Undefined result is never produced

mcqs.answer: c) delete [] on an object and delete on object array
mcqs.explanation: The undefined result is always produced when we try to use delete [] with a single object. Because the type of deletion mismatches. Same in case where we try to apply delete to an object array.

mcqs.question: The delete operator __________________

options.b: b) Invokes function defined by user to delete
options.c: c) Invokes function defined in global scope to delete object

mcqs.explanation: The delete operator invokes the function operator delete. This function in turn performs all the delete operations on the mentioned object. This is ensures safe deletion.

mcqs.question: For objects that are not of class type ______________

options.a: a) Global delete operator is invoked
options.b: b) Local delete operator is invoked
options.c: c) Global user defined function is invoked
options.d: d) Local function to delete object is called

mcqs.answer: a) Global delete operator is invoked
mcqs.explanation: The global delete operator is called to delete the objects that are not of class type. Class type includes class, union or struct. All objects of these types can be deleted using the global delete operator.

mcqs.question: The delete operator __________________________

options.a: a) Can be defined for each class
options.b: b) Can’t be defined for each class
options.c: c) Can be defined globally only
options.d: d) Can’t be defined in a program explicitly

mcqs.answer: a) Can be defined for each class
mcqs.explanation: The delete operator can be defined for each class explicitly. If there is a class for which delete is not defined then the global delete operator is used. The definition of delete operator for each class is not necessary.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Automatic Variable”.

mcqs.question: What are automatic variables?
mcqs.explanation: The local variables are also known as automatic variables. The variables in any local scope that are created and destroyed as the program executes its scope.

mcqs.question: The memory for automatic variables ___________________

options.a: a) Have to be allocated and deallocated explicitly
options.b: b) Are allocated and deallocated automatically

mcqs.answer: b) Are allocated and deallocated automatically
mcqs.explanation: The memory is allocated and deallocated automatically for the automatic variables. As soon as the variable comes in scope, the memory is allocated. The variables are destroyed as soon as those go out of scope.

mcqs.question: Scope of an automatic variable _______________

options.a: a) Is actually the whole program
options.c: c) Is always equal to the whole program execution
options.d: d) Is actually function or block in which it is defined

mcqs.answer: d) Is actually function or block in which it is defined
mcqs.explanation: The automatic variables scope is limited only within the block or the function where those are defined. This is the property of all the automatic variables.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for automatic variables in general?

options.a: a) Automatic variables are invisible to called function
options.b: b) Automatic variables are always visible to the called function
options.c: c) Automatic variables can’t interact with the called function
options.d: d) Automatic variables can’t be variable

mcqs.answer: a) Automatic variables are invisible to called function
mcqs.explanation: The automatic variables are hidden from the called function. Even if passed by reference or address, the address of the variable is used and not the actual variable of calling function. Automatic variables can be const or variable.

mcqs.question: If an automatic variable is created and then a function is called then ________________

options.a: a) The automatic variable created gets destroyed
options.b: b) The automatic variable doesn’t get destroyed
options.c: c) The automatic variable may or may not get destroyed
options.d: d) The automatic variable can’t be used in this case

mcqs.answer: b) The automatic variable doesn’t get destroyed
mcqs.explanation: The automatic variables are saved till the called function gets executed. This is done so as to ensure that the program can continue its execution after the called function is returned. The automatic variables gets destroyed only if those go out of scope.

mcqs.question: Where are the automatic variables stored if another function is called in between the execution of the program?
mcqs.explanation: All the automatic variables are stored in a new stack entry as soon as their scope is created. If another function is called, the present data is saved in stack and new entry in stack is made for the called function. When the function returns, the automatic variables are used again from where those were left.

mcqs.question: The static variables of a function ________________

options.c: c) Are made automatic by default
options.d: d) Can be made automatic explicitly

mcqs.explanation: The static members can’t be automatic. This is because the automatic variables are created and destroyed with each call to a specific function. But the static members remain throughout the execution of program once created.

mcqs.question: All variables declared within a block ____________________
mcqs.explanation: The variables declared inside a block, are make automatic by default. This is to ensure that the variables get destroyed when not required. The variables remain live only till those are required, the life is dependent on the scope of a variable.

mcqs.question: What values does uninitialized automatic variables contain?
mcqs.explanation: The automatic variable which are not initialized, contain garbage value. If we just declare a variable and try to print its value, the result is some unknown value. The value is garbage as that was not expected value.

mcqs.question: Constructor of automatic variables is called ____________________

options.a: a) When execution reaches the place of declaration of automatic variables
options.b: b) When the program is compiled
options.c: c) When the execution is just started
options.d: d) Just before the execution of the program

mcqs.answer: a) When execution reaches the place of declaration of automatic variables
mcqs.explanation: Only when the execution reaches the place where the automatic variable was declared, the constructor is called. This is to ensure that the memory is not allocated if not needed. The memory is allocated and then destroyed as soon as it goes out of scope.

mcqs.question: Does java contain auto or register keywords?

options.a: a) Yes, for declaring every type of variable
options.b: b) Yes, only to declare cache registers
options.c: c) No, because java doesn’t support automatic variables
options.d: d) No, java supports local variable concept

mcqs.answer: d) No, java supports local variable concept
mcqs.explanation: The auto and register keywords are not supported in java. Though the same is allowed in java without specifying any of those keywords. The variables are local variables. But java makes it mandatory to initialize all of the local variables in a program.

mcqs.question: The automatic variables _________________________

options.a: a) Must be declared after its use
options.b: b) Must be declared before using
options.c: c) Must be declared, can be anytime

mcqs.answer: b) Must be declared before using
mcqs.explanation: All the automatic variables in a program must be declared before their use. The compiler won’t allow any use of variable if those are not declared before their use.

mcqs.question: Which error is produced if the automatic variables are used without declaration?
mcqs.explanation: If the automatic variables are used without declaration or are used before the declaration then the compiler throws an error. The error that the symbol is undefined. The compiler must know everything before that can be used.

mcqs.question: In Perl, using which operator are the local variables created?
mcqs.explanation: The language perl supports local variables but the concept is bit different. And if the values are not assigned to the local variables then it contains undef value.

mcqs.question: How are automatic variables different from the instance variables?

options.a: a) Automatic variables are initialized automatically but instances are not
options.b: b) Automatic variables are given zero values initially and not instances
options.c: c) Instance variables have to be initialized explicitly and automatic implicitly
options.d: d) Instance variables are initialized implicitly while automatic are not

mcqs.answer: d) Instance variables are initialized implicitly while automatic are not
mcqs.explanation: The automatic variables have to be initialized explicitly. But in case of instances, those are initialized automatically during execution of the program. The conventions are mandatory.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Extern Variable”.

mcqs.question: What is extern variable?

options.a: a) Variables to be used that are declared in another object file
options.b: b) Variables to be used that are declared in another source file
options.c: c) Variables to be used that are declared in another executable file
options.d: d) Variables to be used that are declared in another program

mcqs.answer: b) Variables to be used that are declared in another source file
mcqs.explanation: The variables that are declared in another source file can be accessed in other files using extern variables. The extern variables must be mentioned explicitly. The source file is included to use its variables.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a correct statement for variables?

options.a: a) Variable can be declared many times
options.b: b) Variable can be declared only one time
options.c: c) Variable declaration can’t be done more than ones
options.d: d) Variable declaration is always done more than one time

mcqs.answer: a) Variable can be declared many times
mcqs.explanation: The variables can be declared any number of times. There is no restriction on how many times a single variables can be declared. Declaration is just an indication that the variable will be used in the program.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is true for the variables?

options.a: a) Variable can be defined only once
options.b: b) Variable can be defined any number of times
options.c: c) Variable must be defined more than one time
options.d: d) Variable can be defined in different files

mcqs.answer: a) Variable can be defined only once
mcqs.explanation: The variables can be defined only once. Once the variable is defined, then it can’t be declared again. The definition of a variable is actual allocation of memory for the variable.

mcqs.question: To use extern variable _____________________

options.a: a) The source file must not be included in the new file code
options.b: b) The source file itself must be used for a new program
options.c: c) The source file must be included in the new file
options.d: d) The source file doesn’t matter for extern variables

mcqs.answer: c) The source file must be included in the new file
mcqs.explanation: The source file must be included in the file which needs to use the extern variable. This is done to ensure that the variables that are already declared can be used again. Only the declarations are used from one file to another.

mcqs.question: What does a header file contain for an extern variable?

options.c: c) Both declaration and definition of variables

mcqs.explanation: The header file only contains the declaration of variables that are extern. It doesn’t contain any static variable definitions.

mcqs.question: Which condition is true if the extern variable is used in a file?

options.a: a) All the header files declare it
options.b: b) Only few required files declare it
options.c: c) All header files declared it if required
options.d: d) Only one header file should declare it

mcqs.answer: d) Only one header file should declare it
mcqs.explanation: Only one header file should declare the extern variable to be used. There must not be more than one file declaring the same extern variable. This is to ensure that there is no ambiguity in using the extern variable.

mcqs.question: Whenever a function is declared in a program _____________________

options.a: a) extern can be used only in some special cases
options.c: c) function is extern by default
options.d: d) it can’t be made extern

mcqs.answer: c) function is extern by default
mcqs.explanation: Even if we don’t specify a function to be extern, by default all the functions are exter. The compiler adds the keyword at the beginning of the function declaration. If there is an extern function to be used then it will be used otherwise the new function only will be used.

mcqs.question: Even if a variable is not declared as extern, it is extern by default.
mcqs.explanation: The statement is false. The variables are not extern by default. If those are made extern by default, then the memory will never be allocated for those extern variables. Hence we make the variables extern explicitly.

mcqs.question: Which of the following results in the allocation of memory for the extern variables?

options.d: d) Memory is not allocated for extern variables

mcqs.explanation: The memory for the extern variables are allocated due to their definition. When the variables are declared, it only indicates the compiler that the variable is going to be used somewhere. But definition makes the compiler to allocate the memory for the variables.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for extern variable declaration?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax firstly contains the keyword extern. Then the data type of the variable is given. Then the variabel name is mentioned by which it will be used in the program.

mcqs.question: Which is the correct syntax for extern function declaration?
mcqs.explanation: The syntax must contain the keyword extern first, to denote that the function is extern. Though the function are extern by default but among the given choices, it should contain the keyword, for explicit declaration. Then the usual function declaration follows.

mcqs.question:
What will be the output of the program? 
extern int var;
int main(void)
{
  var = 10;
  var++;
  cout<<var;
}
mcqs.explanation: The program gives the compiler time error. There is no definition given for the extern variables. This is not allowed and hence we get a compile time error.

mcqs.question: If the definition is given in the header file that we include then ________________
