options.a: a) The program can run successfully
options.b: b) Also the program should define the extern variable
options.c: c) The extern variable must contain two definitions
options.d: d) Extern variable can’t be used in the program

mcqs.answer: a) The program can run successfully
mcqs.explanation: The program runs successfully. This is because only one definition of any variable is allowed. And hence the definition from the source file that is included will be used.

mcqs.question: If extern variable is initialized with the declaration then _______________________

options.a: a) Also the header file with definition is required
options.b: b) The header file with definition must be included
options.c: c) There is no need to include any other header file for definition
options.d: d) The extern variable produces compile time error

mcqs.answer: c) There is no need to include any other header file for definition
mcqs.explanation: When the value for the extern variable is defined with its declaration, then there is no need to include any file for the definition of the variable. The Initialization acts as a definition for the extern variable in the file itself.

mcqs.question: Why are functions extern by default?

options.a: a) Because functions are always private
options.b: b) Because those are not visible throughout the program
options.c: c) Because those can’t be accessed in all parts of the program
options.d: d) Because those are visible throughout the program

mcqs.answer: a) Because functions are always private
mcqs.explanation: The program have all of its functions visible throughout the program usually. Also, there is no specific value that a function must contain. Hence the functions are extern by default.

title: 17. Object Oriented Programming MCQ on Inbuilt Classes

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Inbuilt Classes”.

mcqs.question: What are inbuilt classes?

options.a: a) The predefined classes in a language
options.b: b) The classes that are defined by the user
options.c: c) The classes which are meant to be modified by the user
options.d: d) The classes which can’t be used by the user

mcqs.answer: a) The predefined classes in a language
mcqs.explanation: The classes that are already provided in a programming language for use are inbuilt classes. These classes provide some functions or objects that can be used by the programmer for easier code.

mcqs.question: Inbuilt class __________________________

options.a: a) Must be included before use
options.b: b) Are not necessary to be included for use
options.c: c) Are used by the compiler only
options.d: d) Can be modified by programmer always

mcqs.answer: a) Must be included before use
mcqs.explanation: The inbuilt classes must be included in the program. Whenever some functions are used, they must have a declaration before use. The same is the case with classes.

mcqs.question: What doesn’t inbuilt classes contain?
mcqs.explanation: The classes contain the definitions of the special functions that are provided for the programmers use. Those functions can be used to make the programming easy and to reuse the already existing code.

mcqs.question: Which among the following not an inbuilt class in C++?
mcqs.explanation: There is no inbuilt class named function in java. The others are classes already provided in java. All those classes contain some special functions to be used in programming.

mcqs.question: What is the InputStream class meant for?

options.a: a) To handle all input streams
options.b: b) To handle all output streams
options.c: c) To handle all input and output streams
options.d: d) To handle only input from file

mcqs.answer: a) To handle all input streams
mcqs.explanation: The InputStream is an inbuilt class which is used to handle all the tasks related to input handling. This class extends input from keyboard or file or any other possible input stream.

mcqs.question: Which statement is true for the Array class?

options.a: a) Arrays can have variable length
options.b: b) The length array can be changed
options.c: c) Each class has an associated Array class
options.d: d) Arrays can contain different type of values

mcqs.answer: c) Each class has an associated Array class
mcqs.explanation: The Array class is associated with all the other classes. This gives us the flexibility to declare an array of any type. The index goes from 0 to n, where n is some fixed size for array.

mcqs.question: What is the use of Math class?

options.a: a) To use the mathematical functions with strings
options.b: b) To use the mathematical functions
options.c: c) To suppress the use of mathematical functions

mcqs.answer: b) To use the mathematical functions
mcqs.explanation: The Math class is provided with some special functions. These functions can be used to calculate and get result of some special and usual mathematical functions. We don’t have to write the code to calculate the trigonometric function results, instead we can use Math functions.

mcqs.question: DataInputStream is derived from ______________________
mcqs.explanation: The DataInputStream is more specific class for operating on specific type of data inputs. This is used to read data of specific type. The same can be used to read data in a specific format.

mcqs.question: Which attribute can be used to get the size of an array?
mcqs.explanation: The array name is given of which the length have to be calculated. The array length is stored in the attribute length. Hence we access it using dot operator.

mcqs.question: Number class can’t manipulate ____________________
mcqs.explanation: The Number class is used to work with all the number type of values. The integers, float, double, byte etc. are all number type values. Character is not a number value.

mcqs.question: Which function should be used to exit from the program that is provided by System class?
mcqs.explanation: The exit function should be used to terminate the program. The function is passed with an argument. The argument indicated the type of error occurred.

mcqs.question: Which class contain runFinalization() method?
mcqs.explanation: The runFinalization() Function is defined in the System class. The function is used to finalize an object which undergo destruction. The action is required to terminate the object properly.

mcqs.question: What does load(String)::= function do, in System class?

options.a: a) Loads dynamic library for a path name
options.b: b) Loads all the dynamic libraries
options.c: c) Loads all the Number in string format
options.d: d) Loads the processor with calculations

mcqs.answer: a) Loads dynamic library for a path name
mcqs.explanation: Only the specified path named dynamic libraries are loaded. All the dynamic libraries can’t be loaded at a time. Hence we use this function for specific libraries.

mcqs.question: Which is not a System class variable?
mcqs.explanation: Put is not a System class variable. The most general and basic variables are err, out and in. The variables can handle most of the tasks performed in a program.

mcqs.question: Which package contains the utility classes?
mcqs.explanation: The package java.util contains all the utility classes. This package also contains generic data structures, date, time etc. These can be used in any java program, you just have to include java.util package.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “IO Class”.

mcqs.question: What is the use of IO class?

options.a: a) To handle all the input operations
options.b: b) To handle all the output operations
options.c: c) To handle all the input and output operations
options.d: d) To handle all the input and output to the standard input

mcqs.answer: c) To handle all the input and output operations
mcqs.explanation: The IO class provides functions that can be used to handle input and output operations. All the inputs from standard input and standard output, and also from the files can be handled. This gives the flexibility to make the programs more user friendly.

mcqs.question: IO class provides input and output through ______________________

options.d: d) Data streams, serialization and file system

mcqs.answer: d) Data streams, serialization and file system
mcqs.explanation: The IO classes are made such that those can support the input and output from any type of source or destination. The input can be taken from system file and standard input and also some special devices if conned. Same is case to show the output.

mcqs.question: Which among the following class contains the methods to access character based console device?
mcqs.explanation: The Console class contains the methods to access the character based devices. The devices which can stream the data as character set. All those devices can be made use of by using the methods of class Console.

mcqs.question: File class is ____________________________

options.a: a) An abstract of file representation only
options.b: b) An abstract of path names only
options.c: c) An abstract which can be used to represent path names or file
options.d: d) An abstract which can represent a file in any format

mcqs.answer: c) An abstract which can be used to represent path names or file
mcqs.explanation: The File class is made to operate with the files. The file can be of any type. All the input and output operations that have to be performed on a file can be done using File class object.

mcqs.question: What is a FileDescriptor?

options.a: a) A handle for machine specific structure of an open file
options.b: b) A handle for program specific structure of an open file
options.c: c) A handle for compiler specific structure of an open file
options.d: d) A handle for representing device files structure

mcqs.answer: a) A handle for machine specific structure of an open file
mcqs.explanation: The machine specific structure of an open file have to be handled in some special ways. FileDescriptor class can handle those files. The FileDescriptor can also handle open socket, another source, sink of bytes.

mcqs.question: FileInputStream _________________________

options.a: a) Gets the input stream from any device file
options.b: b) Gets the input stream from any open socket
options.c: c) Gets the input stream from any cache
options.d: d) Gets the input stream from any open file only

mcqs.answer: d) Gets the input stream from any open file only
mcqs.explanation: The most specific answer is that the FileInputStream can only be used for the opened files. The class can work only for the file type. No socket or another source are allowed to be accessed.

mcqs.question: What does FilePermission class do?

options.a: a) This class is used to give permission rights to a file
options.b: b) This class is used to restrict the use of permissions
options.c: c) This class is used to represent device access permissions
options.d: d) This class is used to represent file access permissions

mcqs.answer: d) This class is used to represent file access permissions
mcqs.explanation: The FilePermission can’t get access to the device access permissions. The Permission is given to a file when it is created or otherwise when a privileged user changes it. Then these permission rights can be accessed using the FilePermission class.

mcqs.question: Which class among the following makes incorrect assumptions?
mcqs.explanation: The LineNumberInputStream class makes false assumptions. The false assumption is that it assumes, all the byte data is a character. Which is actually not the case, instead the character have one byte memory space.

mcqs.question: Reader class is _________________

options.a: a) Used to read from files
options.b: b) Abstract class to read character streams
options.c: c) Abstract class to input character streams
options.d: d) Used to take input from standard input stream

mcqs.answer: b) Abstract class to read character streams
mcqs.explanation: The Reader class is an abstract class that can be used to read characters stream. It can’t be used for any kind of input. It can just read the existing data.

mcqs.question: Which class can handle IO class interrupt?
mcqs.explanation: The only class which handles the IO class interrupts is InteruptedIOException class. This class is specially provided to handle any case that involves the execution interrupt.

mcqs.question: StringReader handles _____________________

options.b: b) A character stream whose source is an array
options.c: c) A character stream whose source is character array
options.d: d) A character stream whose source is String only

mcqs.answer: d) A character stream whose source is String only
mcqs.explanation: The StringReader can only work with the string type data. Even if a character array is given, it might produce some errors in code. Hence only the string values can be handled properly.

mcqs.question: Which exception handler can be used when character encoding is not supported?
mcqs.explanation: The encoding that is unsupported in a system can be handled. The exception handler is UnSupportedEncodingException class. An object of this class can be created which will catch the exception and handle it.

mcqs.question: PushBackReader allows the streams to be pushed back to the stream.
mcqs.explanation: The PushBackReader allows the character streams handling. The main feature is that the stream can be pushed back to the stream. This is used in special cases of handling input stream.

mcqs.question: RandomAccessFile can be used to _______________________

options.a: a) Read from a random access file
options.b: b) Write to a random access file
options.c: c) Read and write to a random access file
options.d: d) Restricts read and write to a random access file

mcqs.answer: c) Read and write to a random access file
mcqs.explanation: The RandomAccessFile class instance can be created to handle input and output operations to a random access file. It first checks the permissions on the file and then any required operation can be done on a random access file. Comparatively faster than other files access.

mcqs.question: Which among the following is a serialization descriptor for any class?
mcqs.explanation: The ObjectStreamClass object can be created to handle serializations. The class is provided specially for the serializations. It is descriptor like we have a file descriptor to handle/access files.

links.context: This set of Object Oriented Programming (OOPs) using C++ Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “String Class”.

mcqs.question: Which is a true statement for object of String class?

options.c: c) Object are created only once

mcqs.explanation: The object of string class are mostly immutable. This means that the String objects are constant. These can’t be changed once created.

mcqs.question: How to declare an object of class String?
mcqs.explanation: The class name String is given. And then the object name is mentioned. There are two ways to declare and initialize the string. Either by giving direct string value or by using new keyword. But if new operator is used, constructor of String class have to be called. From the given options, the direct string value declaration is correct.

mcqs.question: What does function length do in String class?

options.a: a) Returns length of string including null character
options.b: b) Returns length of string excluding null character
options.d: d) Returns size of string in bytes

mcqs.answer: b) Returns length of string excluding null character
mcqs.explanation: The length function returns the length of string. The length is the number of characters in the string but the last null character is not counted. The string length can be used to loop through each character in the string.

mcqs.question: Which is the function to get the character present at a particular index in the string?
mcqs.explanation: The function can be called using dot operator with the string object. Char is the return type of the function to return the character at specified position. The index must be an integer value, less than the length of string.

mcqs.question: If only one parameter is passed to substring function then __________________

options.a: a) It returns the character at the specified position
options.b: b) It returns the string of length 1 from the specified index
options.c: c) It returns the string from specified index till the end
options.d: d) It returns the string from starting of string till the specified index

mcqs.answer: c) It returns the string from specified index till the end
mcqs.explanation: The substring function returns a string value. The string is the substring starting from the specified index till the end. The substring function have to be called with the object of string class.

mcqs.question: If two index are given as argument to substring function then ___________________

options.a: a) String of length equal to sum of two arguments is returned
options.b: b) String starting from first index and of length equal to send argument
options.c: c) String starting from first index and of length equal to sum of two arguments
options.d: d) String starting from first index and ending at second index position

mcqs.answer: d) String starting from first index and ending at second index position
mcqs.explanation: A value of string type is returned from this function. The returned string is a substring that starts from the first argument position, till the second index position. The indices must be less than the length of actual string.

mcqs.question: String class have a concat() function that is used to _____________________

options.a: a) Replace old string by new string
options.c: c) Append one string at end of another string
options.d: d) Remove a string from end of one string

mcqs.answer: c) Append one string at end of another string
mcqs.explanation: The concat function is used to append string into another string. The new string is always appended at the end of source string. The target string is appended as it is and the whole string is then ended by null character.

mcqs.question: The function lastIndexOf() is used to ___________________

options.a: a) Get the index of last occurrence of specified character in argument
options.b: b) Get the index of first occurrence of specified character in argument
options.c: c) Get the index of last occurrence of first character in string
options.d: d) Get the index of last occurrence of last character of string

mcqs.answer: a) Get the index of last occurrence of specified character in argument
mcqs.explanation: The function is used to get the last occurrence index of a character present in a string. The return type is char. Single character is returned. The function is used with a string object and the target character is passed as its argument.

mcqs.question: Function equals() is _______________ and equalIgnoreCase() is _________________
mcqs.explanation: Both the functions return Boolean value. The function equal() is case sensitive and returns false even if a single character is case different in two strings. The other function ignores the case sensitivity and only checks if the spellings are same.

mcqs.question: The compareTo() function is used to ________________

options.a: a) Compare strings value to string object
options.b: b) Compare string value to string value
options.c: c) Compare string object to another string object
options.d: d) Compare string object to another string value

mcqs.answer: c) Compare string object to another string object
mcqs.explanation: The source and target must be objects of the string class. The compare is always case sensitive. To compare two string objects without case sensitivity then we can use compareToIgnoreCase() function.

mcqs.question: String class provides function toUpper() to _____________________

options.a: a) Convert first character to uppercase
options.b: b) Convert last character to uppercase
options.c: c) Convert the whole string characters to uppercase
options.d: d) Convert uppercase to lower and lower to uppercases

mcqs.answer: c) Convert the whole string characters to uppercase
mcqs.explanation: The function is used to convert each character of the string. If the character is already uppercase then it remains the same. But if some character is in lowercase then it will be converted to uppercase.

mcqs.question: String trim() function is used to _______________________

options.a: a) Remove all the white spaces from the string
options.b: b) Remove white space from start of string
options.c: c) Remove white space at end of string
options.d: d) Remove white space from both the ends of string

mcqs.answer: d) Remove white space from both the ends of string
mcqs.explanation: The function is used to remove any white space from both the ends of a given string. The white space include space, tab, next line etc. It will be removed both from the starting of string and from the end of string.

mcqs.question: Function replace() accepts _____________ arguments.
mcqs.explanation: The first argument is the target character. This target character will be replaced by another character. The new character is the second argument to the function. Only the characters can be passed as argument, not a string.

mcqs.question: If two arguments are passed to the indexOf() function then ___________________

options.a: a) Second argument indicates the occurrence number of specified character from starting
options.b: b) Second argument indicates the occurrence number of specified character from end
options.c: c) Second argument indicates the index of the character in first argument
options.d: d) Second argument indicates the index of the character from the last of the string

mcqs.answer: a) Second argument indicates the occurrence number of specified character from starting
mcqs.explanation: The string may have more than one occurrence of a character. We use this function to get the index at which the specified number of times a specific character has occurred in a string. For example, we can get the index of 5th occurrence of character “j” in a string.

mcqs.question: The string class deals with string of only character type.
mcqs.explanation: The string class objects can be used for any string consisting of characters. The characters include numbers, alphabets and few special characters. String class is not necessary to be used but provides a huge set of inbuilt functions to make the string operations easier.
